/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6564:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然文本里也混了身份信息和模态信息，就把提示拆成身份 token 和模态 token，再用不含模态描述的 partial prompt 做 visible-text 和 infrared-text 居中。既然固定提示会过期，就交替训练文本提示和图像编码器，形成 spiral training。这个机制和重定义绑定较紧，但训练序列靠经验选，稍微削弱了“自然推出”的纯度。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6566:4. 证据闭环：关键不是最终 SOTA，而是 STD、MCL、ST 的组合消融。表 6 到表 8 分别证明可分离文本、模态居中、螺旋训练各有作用；表 7 拆 text-to-text 和 image-to-text centering，说明“居中”不是空话。遗憾是没有更直接画出四个空间距离随训练收敛的轨迹，所以闭环是中等强度。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6608:1. 触发观察：车辆 ReID 真实训练数据受隐私和标注成本限制，3D 引擎数据有域差，GAN 数据细粒度属性不稳定。车辆类内差异很小，前格栅、尾灯、车身类型、颜色错一点，合成数据就会误导训练。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6612:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果问题是属性一致性和真实域风格，就先建车辆属性 prompt 库；如果通用 diffusion 不贴近目标域，就用 1% 无标签真实图经 BLIP-2 生成 caption，再用 LoRA 方式微调 diffusion；如果生成图会多车、碎车、颜色错，就用 YOLO 裁车、CLIP 做颜色语义过滤；最后用 CE 和 circle loss 训练任意 ReID 模型。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6620:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6622:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6624:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6626:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6628:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2142:./ondisk_pivot.md:3790:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:8:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2145:./ondisk_pivot.md:3812:./debate/clean/d_1.txt:6:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2166:./ondisk_pivot.md:4738:./reassess/r_3.md:8684:4. **证据闭环**：核心消融在 SYSU-MM01。baseline 是 72.25 mAP、75.22 rank-1；加 ATG 到 73.28、76.47；加 CTP 到 73.13、76.21；ATG+CTP 到 74.86、77.85；完整 TRM 到 76.21、78.52。这个表刚好证明三个判断：属性文本有用，轮廓文本也有用，两者互补，TRM 不是多余融合。作者还和传统 VI-ReID 以及语言模型方法对比，强调 richer textual prompts 能更好指导视觉编码器提取 modality-invariant feature。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2167:./ondisk_pivot.md:4740:./reassess/r_3.md:8690:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4423:./debate/d_2.md:84:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4476:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1164:4. **证据闭环**：核心消融在 SYSU-MM01。baseline 是 72.25 mAP、75.22 rank-1；加 ATG 到 73.28、76.47；加 CTP 到 73.13、76.21；ATG+CTP 到 74.86、77.85；完整 TRM 到 76.21、78.52。这个表刚好证明三个判断：属性文本有用，轮廓文本也有用，两者互补，TRM 不是多余融合。作者还和传统 VI-ReID 以及语言模型方法对比，强调 richer textual prompts 能更好指导视觉编码器提取 modality-invariant feature。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4477:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1170:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4520:./debate/d_1.md:84:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4526:./debate/d_1.md:118:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5569:./reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5938:./reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:40:Top-30 hub galleries vs camera-matched controls: hubs are brighter (140 vs 119), more colorful (18 vs 11), and a bright high-contrast scene (a parked orange car + brick plaza) is over-represented (~7–8/30 vs 0–1/30 base rate). Critically, the 30 hubs span **24 distinct identities** yet cluster with mean pairwise cosine **0.166** (control 0.025); each hub's 10-NN contains 26.7% other top-1% hubs (27× the 1% base rate). The model groups unrelated identities by a **shared non-identity factor**—the scene—producing the cross-ID attraction. (All replicated within camera-0 to exclude camera confound.)

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_12.md:8207:**重定义动作：** 它把问题从“ReID 需要语言监督”推进成“全身级语言监督不足以约束局部语义一致性”。关键词是 within-part semantic inconsistency、part-informed visual-language learning、pixel-level text prompts、fine-grained image-text alignment。它还补了一层冲突定义：human parsing 是身份无关的，而 ReID 要身份相关判别，直接用 parsing 会和身份学习冲突。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_12.md:8216:**触发观察：** 文本到图像 ReID 的对比学习默认“非配对样本都是负样本”。作者指出这个假设在 TIReID 里不成立，因为文本描述可能适配多个行人，标注或描述粒度也会造成语义相近的假负样本。把这些样本推远会破坏跨模态对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_12.md:8224:**reviewer 为什么买账：** 这篇卖的是一个训练假设错误，而不是新 backbone。reviewer 容易买账的点是：假负样本问题在 TIReID 里直观存在，而且方法可以作为对比学习插件加到强模型上。novelty 来自“把负样本污染作为核心问题”，不是来自 GMM 或 queue 本身。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_12.md:8227:**触发观察：** 真实 ReID 部署同时有两个矛盾：跨域泛化需要多域信息，但隐私限制不允许直接共享数据；联邦学习能保隐私，但普通 FL 只是聚合本地偏置模型，没有解决域漂移。作者进一步把漂移观察拆成两类：风格差异，比如亮度、色调、纹理；视角差异，比如摄像头角度不同。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:10670:reviews/deep_25.md:14075:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:10671:reviews/deep_25.md:14083:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:906:./reviews/deep_20.md:6354:2. 重定义动作：他们把 ReID 从“图像外观匹配”重定义成“跨地点、跨年份的运动生物特征识别”。HAR 也不是作为动作分类任务，而是作为步态身份表示的上下文补充。关键词是 long-term、spatio-temporal ReID、gait、HAR、cross-year、motion-based multimodal representation、context-aware activity cues。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:907:./reviews/deep_20.md:6356:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用检测、跟踪和分割得到 silhouette 序列，再用 gait backbone 提取部位级步态特征。方法里一个细节很关键，他们承认 BiLSTM 处理的是身体水平部位序列，不是真正时间序列，用它建模部位之间的结构关系。HAR 分支用预训练视频 backbone，做 context-constrained crop，最后让 gait 作为 query 去 attend HAR，保证身份主线仍由 gait 主导。机制和重定义绑定比较紧，技术本身不新，但角色分配清楚。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:914:./reviews/deep_20.md:6390:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:944:./reviews/deep_15.md:8496:EAIBC 的前 8 页覆盖了完整方法：观察来自检索失败样例和 RGB/灰度响应图差异，机制是四分支互学。还要补它的颜色分支和互学习优化段落，随后可以进入综合拆解。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:952:./reviews/deep_15.md:13765:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“去掉衣服影响”改写成“粗糙重建缺少真实的人体解析约束和非邻域上下文”。关键词是 `human parsing reconstruction`、`non-local multi-scale perception`、`contextual correlation`、`global receptive field`、`multi-local component generation`。大家以为只要分离衣服相关和无关特征，其实分离过程本身如果没有上下文和解析约束，会制造新的偏差。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:953:./reviews/deep_15.md:13772:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:954:./reviews/deep_15.md:13779:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题从“做数据增强”改成“生成能训练 ReID 的身份一致跨模态数据”。关键词是 `controllable diffusion`、`infrared modality understanding`、`text adapter alignment`、`identity-aware generation`、`Generated Cross-modal Person Dataset`。大家以为生成更多图片就行，其实 ReID 合成数据必须同时满足红外风格、文本语义、身份一致和跨模态配对。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:955:./reviews/deep_15.md:13780:3. **机制怎么长出来**：每个机制对应一个失败点。LoRA 用 SYSU-MM01 的可见光和红外图微调 UNet，让扩散模型学会红外概念。BLIP 生成图文对，再加 “RGB photo” 和 “infrared photo” 前缀。Text adapter 用 LLaMA 的语义能力校准原始 CLIP text encoder。生成阶段先用文本生成 RGB reference，再用 IP-Adapter 保持身份生成多视角 RGB，最后用 ControlNet SoftEdge 把 RGB 转成红外。OpenPose 和灰度化等后处理用于清洗低质量样本。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:956:./reviews/deep_15.md:13785:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:957:./reviews/deep_15.md:13786:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“跨模态对齐不够好”改成“颜色过度依赖导致模型忽略纹理、结构和局部物品”。关键词是 `color over-reliance`、`all-round information beyond color`、`grayscale branch`、`high-frequency branch`、`color branch`、`mutual learning`。大家以为颜色是最强线索要强化，其实颜色太强会遮蔽其他可判别线索。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:958:./reviews/deep_15.md:13788:4. **证据闭环**：这篇证据很完整。先用检索失败样例和 RGB/GRS response maps 证明颜色过度依赖存在。消融证明单分支不如多分支，加入 CLR branch 和 mutual learning 后更好。feature response map 显示 RGB 分支看粉色衣服，GRS 分支看自行车、包、箱子等非颜色线索。检索例子说明 EAIBC 能把颜色相似但细节不符的人往后排。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:959:./reviews/deep_15.md:13793:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“合成数据规模不够大”改成“合成数据的泛化能力由纹理真实性和监控采集协议决定”。关键词是 `diffusion-generated UV texture`、`reliable clothing texture`、`sub-monitoring network`、`scalable synthetic pipeline`、`direct transfer`。大家以为扩大身份数和场景数就能提升合成数据，其实 UV 纹理定义和监控网络模拟才是关键瓶颈。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:960:./reviews/deep_15.md:13794:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MakeHuman 生成不同体型、肤色、发型的人体模型，再加骨架和行走动画。衣服模型本身没有足够纹理，于是用 normal maps 条件训练 ControlNet，引导 Stable Diffusion 生成和衣服表面结构对齐的 UV texture maps，再导入 UE4 材质系统。采集上设计 sub-monitoring network，每个子网络用少量摄像头覆盖局部区域，并让人物沿循环路径移动，控制视角、背景、光照和遮挡。UnrealCV 自动得到实例分割和裁剪。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1117:./reviews/deep_7.md:7021:2. 重定义动作：它把视频 ReID 从“时间聚合问题”改成“无需外部人体拓扑的语义自对齐问题”。作者强调的不是再做 attention，而是用视频自身上下文学习 pixel-level part-aligned representation 和 semantic-aligned global representation。关键词是 self-alignment、context-aided、semantic-aware、without prior human topology。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1254:./analyses/deep_12.txt:17:**重定义动作：** 它把问题从“ReID 需要语言监督”推进成“全身级语言监督不足以约束局部语义一致性”。关键词是 within-part semantic inconsistency、part-informed visual-language learning、pixel-level text prompts、fine-grained image-text alignment。它还补了一层冲突定义：human parsing 是身份无关的，而 ReID 要身份相关判别，直接用 parsing 会和身份学习冲突。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1397:./reviews/deep_9.md:6909:4. 证据闭环：核心消融是融合方式和文本约束。cross-attention 比直接相加好很多，直接相加甚至会明显伤性能，说明“非对称融合”不是装饰。损失消融里，只有 learnable text、只有 description text、二者组合和完整约束逐步提升，说明描述文本确实是辅助增强而不是替代视觉或替代 prompt。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1835:./analyses/deep_8.txt:34:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1873:./reviews/deep_25.md:14037:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“把 RGB ReID 迁移到事件数据”，而是讲成“事件 ReID 的核心是 sparse semantic denoising and enhancement”。关键词是 sparse event semantics、event noise、frequency-domain denoising、multi-grain semantic interaction、event contextual semantics。这样一来，旧问题从“缺一个更强 ReID 网络”变成“事件流的语义和噪声强耦合，需要同时去噪和增强上下文”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1882:./reviews/deep_25.md:14073:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题讲成“跨模态对齐缺少显式、模态无关的 semantic anchor”，而不是“再做一个 CLIP prompt”。关键词是 attribute-aware text、contour-aware text prompt、text re-definition、category-level textual prototypes、modality-agnostic semantic anchors。这个重定义把文本从辅助描述变成“RGB 和 IR 共同对齐的类别原型”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1883:./reviews/deep_25.md:14075:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1887:./reviews/deep_25.md:14097:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1888:./reviews/deep_25.md:14099:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1890:./reviews/deep_25.md:14103:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是“对遮挡失败类型的细分”加“机制一一对应”。如果只说 pose+texture，novelty 会弱；但作者先指出 pose 方法在极端遮挡和行人遮挡下分别为什么失效，再让 PPM 和 TAD 分别处理，reviewer 就更容易接受。真正 novelty 来自问题拆解，而不是 Transformer、pose 或 attention 本身。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1892:./reviews/deep_25.md:14116:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“把 RGB ReID 迁移到事件数据”，而是讲成“事件 ReID 的核心是 sparse semantic denoising and enhancement”。关键词是 sparse event semantics、event noise、frequency-domain denoising、multi-grain semantic interaction、event contextual semantics。这样一来，旧问题从“缺一个更强 ReID 网络”变成“事件流的语义和噪声强耦合，需要同时去噪和增强上下文”。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2776:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3981:experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:405:按用户睡前"不停+cheap kill-switch first"，自主把 TBPS 唯一幸存候选 PartNC 推到"数据一到就能判生死"：agent 读懂 RDE 接口(checkpoint 加载 / image 192-patch+text 77-token 特征 / CCD 的 min-max+2-GMM+低均值簇后验)，写 `scripts/partnc_killswitch.py`(本地+lab-3090-d，md5 一致)：(a) spaCy+lexicon 切 caption head/torso/legs + 部位级噪声注入(参数化, 有 regex fallback)；(b) RDE token 特征算 noun-phrase×patch per-part MaxSim cleanliness(复刻 eval_fliptest_maxsim einsum.max)；(c) AUROC(part-level) vs AUROC(实例级CCD)；(d) verdict。逻辑全验证通过(切分/注入/加载/形状/MaxSim/GMM/AUROC 方向性单测)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2781:../codex_review_ovli.txt:3986:experiments/exp210/claude_review.md:18:- 动机清晰：MaxSim test-time 证明 per-keypoint features 有强 matching 信号，但训练时只受间接监督（pooled CE + triplet）。PKC 直接对每个 keypoint feature 做 SupCon，让每个 keypoint 独立学 discriminative representation�”改写成“粗糙重建缺少真实的人体解析约束和非邻域上下文”。关键词是 `human parsing reconstruction`、`non-local multi-scale perception`、`contextual correlation`、`global receptive field`、`multi-local component generation`。大家以为只要分离衣服相关和无关特征，其实分离过程本身如果没有上下文和解析约束，会制造新的偏差。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2782:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:404:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2783:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:411:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题从“做数据增强”改成“生成能训练 ReID 的身份一致跨模态数据”。关键词是 `controllable diffusion`、`infrared modality understanding`、`text adapter alignment`、`identity-aware generation`、`Generated Cross-modal Person Dataset`。大家以为生成更多图片就行，其实 ReID 合成数据必须同时满足红外风格、文本语义、身份一致和跨模态配对。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2784:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:412:3. **机制怎么长出来**：每个机制对应一个失败点。LoRA 用 SYSU-MM01 的可见光和红外图微调 UNet，让扩散模型学会红外概念。BLIP 生成图文对，再加 “RGB photo” 和 “infrared photo” 前缀。Text adapter 用 LLaMA 的语义能力校准原始 CLIP text encoder。生成阶段先用文本生成 RGB reference，再用 IP-Adapter 保持身份生成多视角 RGB，最后用 ControlNet SoftEdge 把 RGB 转成红外。OpenPose 和灰度化等后处理用于清洗低质量样本。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2785:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:417:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2786:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:418:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“跨模态对齐不够好”改成“颜色过度依赖导致模型忽略纹理、结构和局部物品”。关键词是 `color over-reliance`、`all-round information beyond color`、`grayscale branch`、`high-frequency branch`、`color branch`、`mutual learning`。大家以为颜色是最强线索要强化，其实颜色太强会遮蔽其他可判别线索。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2787:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:420:4. **证据闭环**：这篇证据很完整。先用检索失败样例和 RGB/GRS response maps 证明颜色过度依赖存在。消融证明单分支不如多分支，加入 CLR branch 和 mutual learning 后更好。feature response map 显示 RGB 分支看粉色衣服，GRS 分支看自行车、包、箱子等非颜色线索。检索例子说明 EAIBC 能把颜色相似但细节不符的人往后排。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2788:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:425:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“合成数据规模不够大”改成“合成数据的泛化能力由纹理真实性和监控采集协议决定”。关键词是 `diffusion-generated UV texture`、`reliable clothing texture`、`sub-monitoring network`、`scalable synthetic pipeline`、`direct transfer`。大家以为扩大身份数和场景数就能提升合成数据，其实 UV 纹理定义和监控网络模拟才是关键瓶颈。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2789:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:426:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MakeHuman 生成不同体型、肤色、发型的人体模型，再加骨架和行走动画。衣服模型本身没有足够纹理，于是用 normal maps 条件训练 ControlNet，引导 Stable Diffusion 生成和衣服表面结构对齐的 UV texture maps，再导入 UE4 材质系统。采集上设计 sub-monitoring network，每个子网络用少量摄像头覆盖局部区域，并让人物沿循环路径移动，控制视角、背景、光照和遮挡。UnrealCV 自动得到实例分割和裁剪。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2793:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:446:2. 重定义动作：他们把 Sketch ReID 从“一次性草图检索”改写成“用户反馈驱动的交互检索”。关键词是 context assistance、feedback guidance、pseudo-word token、explicit sketch-text compositionality、textual token concatenation。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2794:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:454:2. 重定义动作：他们把注意力问题从“样本内部哪里重要”改写成“样本内部局部上下文应该和跨样本潜在上下文交互”。关键词是 internal-external context interaction、inter-sample latent context、intra-sample local context、external learnable memory。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2828:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:646:1. 触发观察：作者注意到换衣 ReID 里单一线索都不可靠。RGB 外观会被衣服误导，mask 或 silhouette 丢掉颜色、脸部和配饰等有用线索，身体局部裁剪又会受背景和局部噪声影响。简单拼接多个特征也不够，因为不同特征权重固定，空间语义也未对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2841:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:711:1. **触发观察**：作者观察到两层失败。第一，global image-text matching 太粗，分不开外观相似但细节属性不同的人。第二，以前的 attribute-aware 方法也不彻底，常常只抽文本属性，再和全局图像特征匹配，粒度不对；或者把属性当辅助监督，最后被身份分类和实例对齐压住。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2845:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:723:1. **触发观察**：作者从 UDA ReID 三类主流方法的痛点切入：特征对齐常要辅助信息，图像风格迁移依赖 GAN 且训练不稳，聚类伪标签会传播错误。另一个观察是，卷积的局部感受野不足以处理跨域干扰，标准 self-attention 又贵且常要改 backbone。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2856:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:806:2. 重定义动作：他们把 ReID 从“图像外观匹配”重定义成“跨地点、跨年份的运动生物特征识别”。HAR 也不是作为动作分类任务，而是作为步态身份表示的上下文补充。关键词是 long-term、spatio-temporal ReID、gait、HAR、cross-year、motion-based multimodal representation、context-aware activity cues。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2857:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:808:3. 机制怎么长出来：先用检测、跟踪和分割得到 silhouette 序列，再用 gait backbone 提取部位级步态特征。方法里一个细节很关键，他们承认 BiLSTM 处理的是身体水平部位序列，不是真正时间序列，用它建模部位之间的结构关系。HAR 分支用预训练视频 backbone，做 context-constrained crop，最后让 gait 作为 query 去 attend HAR，保证身份主线仍由 gait 主导。机制和重定义绑定比较紧，技术本身不新，但角色分配清楚。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2864:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:842:2. 重定义动作：这是最值得学的一篇。它把“车辆是噪声”改写成“车辆是有结构的正向噪声”。关键词是 positive noise、positive-incentive noise、structured cross-domain noise、data-centric perspective、vehicle data as valuable training resource、without manual annotations。旧问题是遮挡建模，新问题是如何用真实跨域干扰物降低遮挡识别的不确定性。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2881:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:940:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“图文相似度对齐”改写成“文本分布应当包含图像分布”。关键词是 probabilistic containment、semantic scope、partial-order relationship、text as probabilistic envelope。厉害的地方是把方差从“噪声余量”重新定义成“语义覆盖范围”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2894:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:990:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2909:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1029:2. **重定义动作**：它把换衣问题从“消除衣服”改写成“分离负语义并显式挖出正语义”。关键词是 `negative factors`、`positive factors`、`semantic contextual integration`、`semantic separation`、`orthogonalized text features`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2931:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1124:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“把 RGB ReID 迁移到事件数据”，而是讲成“事件 ReID 的核心是 sparse semantic denoising and enhancement”。关键词是 sparse event semantics、event noise、frequency-domain denoising、multi-grain semantic interaction、event contextual semantics。这样一来，旧问题从“缺一个更强 ReID 网络”变成“事件流的语义和噪声强耦合，需要同时去噪和增强上下文”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2940:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1160:2. **重定义动作**：作者把问题讲成“跨模态对齐缺少显式、模态无关的 semantic anchor”，而不是“再做一个 CLIP prompt”。关键词是 attribute-aware text、contour-aware text prompt、text re-definition、category-level textual prototypes、modality-agnostic semantic anchors。这个重定义把文本从辅助描述变成“RGB 和 IR 共同对齐的类别原型”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2941:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1162:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2945:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1184:2. **重定义动作**：他们没有把问题讲成“遮挡区域检测不准”，而是拆成“pose misalignment under extreme occlusion”和“identity confusion caused by non-target pedestrian occlusion”。关键词是 pose-patch mapping、texture-aware decoder、non-target pedestrian occlusion、structure and detail dual constraints。这个拆解让方法天然有两个核心动作：结构上精确映射，细节上用纹理区分目标。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2946:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1186:3. **机制怎么长出来**：MFE 先在 ViT patch 上做 intra-patch 和 inter-patch 编码，补足 patch 内外层级信息。PPM 不做 pose-to-global，而是把 pose 和 patch 当成两种模态，用 Mahalanobis distance 加 cosine similarity 建 pose-patch 相似矩阵，只保留高置信关键点对应的 patch，从而降低局部 pose 错误的全局污染。TAD 再用 context extraction layer 和 texture extraction layer，以 PPM 过滤后的 pose 特征为约束，通过 cross-attention 强化可区分纹理。pose loss 还约束人体和非人体映射特征不要太相似。机制和两个失败场景绑定得比较紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2948:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1190:5. **reviewer 为什么买账**：这篇卖的是“对遮挡失败类型的细分”加“机制一一对应”。如果只说 pose+texture，novelty 会弱；但作者先指出 pose 方法在极端遮挡和行人遮挡下分别为什么失效，再让 PPM 和 TAD 分别处理，reviewer 就更容易接受。真正 novelty 来自问题拆解，而不是 Transformer、pose 或 attention 本身。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2953:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1227:2. 重定义动作：他们把 LReID 从“防止忘记过去”重定义为“过去、现在、未来三类域同时负责”。关键词是 text prompts、domain-consistent features、future-style generation、past-present-future domains。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2954:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1229:3. 机制怎么长出来：文本更稳定，所以用文本 prompt 作为跨域语义锚；域按顺序到来，所以 prompt generator 和 image encoder 交替、连续更新；未来域不可见，所以在特征空间用风格对抗扰动模拟未来样本，再让文本和原图、未来风格图一起对齐。逻辑比较紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2989:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1369:它把 prompt 从“给图像编码器用的静态文本辅助”改写成“可学习的中间模态”。关键词是 mutual promotion、mutual reinforcement、person-related prompts、text features as bridge、modality knowledge propagation、modality alignment、alternating training。旧问题是“怎么用文本帮助可见光和红外对齐”，新问题是“提示和图像编码器怎样互相变好”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3002:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1453:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 过去常把跨模态差异当作要消除的东西，结果共享对齐会丢掉可见光颜色纹理、红外热特征这些细节；生成式补偿又会引入噪声或依赖辅助模型。BDLF 论文页面也明确把缺口说成“只挖 shared，忽略 modality-specific details”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03286))
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3005:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1462:2. 重定义动作：标题已经在重定义：“不要只讲 geometry，texture 才是 3D ReID 的关键”。进一步把解释性从事后可视化改成检索信号。关键词是 UVTexture、canonical viewpoint、viewpoint-invariant explanation、Intersection-Alignment Score、explainable re-ranking。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3019:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1526:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3020:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1528:3. 机制怎么长出来：机制基本是顺着这个重定义长出来的。主体 token S* 来自全局图像特征，表示“这是谁”；属性 token A* 由 learnable queries 从 patch 中提取可见身份属性；上下文 token O* 提取遮挡物特征。三者组成 “A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*]” 这样的细粒度 prompt，再用文本作为 query 对视觉 patch 做 cross-attention，引导图像特征看可见人体区域、压掉遮挡物。动态融合用预测不确定性给 visual、text、cross-attention feature 分配权重，是对可靠性问题的补强。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3041:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1609:2. 重定义动作：它把问题从“给 CLIP 加 fine-grained alignment”改写成“在不引入外部工具、不破坏 CLIP 预训练空间的前提下挖细粒度关系”。关键词是 pre-training space compatibility、explicit fine-grained mining、attention bias forward、text extraction strategy、visual bridge、momentum distillation。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3045:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1629:2. 重定义动作：他们没有把问题讲成“再做一个跨模态对齐损失”，而是讲成“四个异质空间没有被同时居中”：可见图像、红外图像、可见文本、红外文本。关键词是 `separable text description`、`modality centering`、`identity-aware`、`modality-aware`、`semantic consistency`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3046:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1631:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然文本里也混了身份信息和模态信息，就把提示拆成身份 token 和模态 token，再用不含模态描述的 partial prompt 做 visible-text 和 infrared-text 居中。既然固定提示会过期，就交替训练文本提示和图像编码器，形成 spiral training。这个机制和重定义绑定较紧，但训练序列靠经验选，稍微削弱了“自然推出”的纯度。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3055:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1687:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3056:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1689:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3057:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1691:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3058:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1693:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3059:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1695:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3069:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1744:2. 重定义动作：它把视频 ReID 从“时间聚合问题”改成“无需外部人体拓扑的语义自对齐问题”。作者强调的不是再做 attention，而是用视频自身上下文学习 pixel-level part-aligned representation 和 semantic-aligned global representation。关键词是 self-alignment、context-aided、semantic-aware、without prior human topology。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3079:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1787:2. 重定义动作：他们把问题从“图文对齐”改写成“跨模态互补协作”，再把正样本从一个类别拆成“强正、弱正、负样本”的有界匹配问题。关键词是 `complementarity`、`virtual-text`、`collaboration`、`identity-bounded matching`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3092:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1815:2. 重定义动作：作者把 CCReID 从“学习衣服不变视觉特征”改写成“用异质语义描述引导视觉特征摆脱衣服偏置”。关键词是 `semantic guidance`、`visual bottleneck`、`multi-description`、`RGB and gray-scale pseudo-text`、`heterogeneous semantic fusion`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3093:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1816:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3098:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1833:1. 触发观察：作者抓到的是“对齐会伤判别性”。VI-ReID 里大家都在缩小可见光和红外的模态差异，但直接做分布对齐会把不同身份也拉近，颜色、纹理等细粒度线索也被洗掉。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3102:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1841:2. 重定义动作：它把问题从“文本能不能帮助 ReID”改成“两类文本嵌入的可靠性和粒度不同，不能对称使用”。关键词是 learnable-based textual embedding、description-based textual embedding、asymmetric fusion、auxiliary clues、cross-granularity training。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3103:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1843:4. 证据闭环：核心消融是融合方式和文本约束。cross-attention 比直接相加好很多，直接相加甚至会明显伤性能，说明“非对称融合”不是装饰。损失消融里，只有 learnable text、只有 description text、二者组合和完整约束逐步提升，说明描述文本确实是辅助增强而不是替代视觉或替代 prompt。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3108:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1855:2. 重定义动作：它把旧问题“无监督跨模态学习”改成“训练样本和伪标签的 dependability 问题”。关键词是 dependable text generation、reliable image-text matching relationship、Error Sample Filtering、dependable identity labels。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3109:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1858:5. reviewer 为什么买账：买的是问题分解。它没有简单说“大模型生成文本能用”，而是说无监督 TIReID 的难点在两层可靠性：图文关系可靠、伪身份可靠。novelty 来源是数据构造和可靠性过滤的闭环，机制和重定义绑定较紧。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:6:Modern person ReID backbones (Swin/SOLIDER) reach 73–95 mAP, yet a non-trivial residual of queries still fail. We ask **where** these failures concentrate, and show they are not well explained by per-query pairwise difficulty. Instead, we identify a **topological** hidden variable: a small set of gallery images act as **negative attraction hubs**—each is pulled into the top-k of *many queries of different identities*. We formalize this as the gallery **negative in-degree** `H_k(g)` and the per-query **hub mass** `M(q)`, and show on Occluded-Duke and Market-1501 that (i) `M(q)` explains per-query AP error with Spearman ρ up to **+0.65** (perm-p<0.001), surviving partial-correlation control against feature-norm, top-1 margin, camera, and #positives; (ii) negative in-degree is **near-orthogonal** to generic sample popularity (all in-degree); (iii) high-hub galleries cluster in feature space across *24 distinct identities* (mean pairwise cosine 0.166 vs 0.025 control; 27× hub-enrichment in their kNN) because the model **over-encodes a non-identity scene factor**. We are explicit that the *remedy* for this failure is already covered by k-reciprocal re-ranking and camera-aware corrections; our contribution is a **clean, falsifiable diagnosis** of the residual-failure structure of strong ReID, not a new retrieval method.
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:13:- Destructive controls (permutation, partial-correlation, negative-vs-all in-degree) establish the variable is real, independent, and specifically *negative*.
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:15:- We honestly bound the contribution: the remedy lies within the space already covered by k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking, so this is a **diagnosis**, not a method.
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:18:**Re-ranking / neighbor topology.** k-reciprocal re-ranking and CA-Jaccard exploit gallery-gallery neighbor structure at test time; they *fix* part of the topology we diagnose, but do not *define* negative in-degree as the failure variable nor isolate it from camera bias. **Hubness in retrieval.** Radović et al. define hubness in high-dim kNN; CSLS/Mutual-Proximity are post-hoc hub corrections in cross-modal retrieval; HAL/NeighborRetr add training-time hubness-aware losses for image-text. None target person-ReID gallery negative in-degree as a residual-failure diagnostic. **Difficulty-aware ReID.** Hard-negative mining and difficulty-adaptive inference use per-image difficulty; our variable is relation-level (many-to-one absorption), not per-image hardness.

The failure variable is specifically *cross-identity* absorption, not generic popularity.
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:40:Top-30 hub galleries vs camera-matched controls: hubs are brighter (140 vs 119), more colorful (18 vs 11), and a bright high-contrast scene (a parked orange car + brick plaza) is over-represented (~7–8/30 vs 0–1/30 base rate). Critically, the 30 hubs span **24 distinct identities** yet cluster with mean pairwise cosine **0.166** (control 0.025); each hub's 10-NN contains 26.7% other top-1% hubs (27× the 1% base rate). The model groups unrelated identities by a **shared non-identity factor**—the scene—producing the cross-ID attraction. (All replicated within camera-0 to exclude camera confound.)
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:43:We tested the obvious remedies and report them honestly. A zero-training hub penalty `score' = cos − λ·log(1+H_k)` gives only +0.31 (Market) / +1.51 (Occluded-Duke) mAP, and is **dominated** by same-camera down-weighting (+0.67 / +3.13) and k-reciprocal (+1.26 / **+10.98**)—the gap *widens* on the harder set. A training-side anti-hub embedding sits in the same space already covered by re-ranking. The mechanism (scene over-encoding) points to background/region suppression, which is non-generalizable here (a dataset-specific scene) and overlaps prior pose-masked suppression. We therefore present negative in-degree as a **diagnostic**: it tells you *where* strong ReID fails and *why* (gallery topology / non-identity factor), while the *fix* remains the province of established test-time tools.

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/RANKREGRET_RESULT.md:35:- **stage2（cheap 可用, 这才是关键反例）**: RI marginal 看似不错（+0.39/+0.11）, 但**控住 8 个静态代理后 partial 塌到 +0.045 / −0.057** —— 即当 cheap 特征足够有信息量时, RI 几乎**完全**由静态难度解释。这正是 CFPER：RI ≡ 静态难度。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/RANKREGRET_RESULT.md:36:- 结论: RI 不是独立于难度的「关系级」信号; 它就是难度的一种含噪测量。**Test B FAIL ×4 → 撞 CFPER。**

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/RANKREGRET_RESULT.md:50:1. **Test B（撞 CFPER）FAIL**: RI 从不beat 静态难度; cheap 可用时 partial 塌到 0 = RI≡难度。先前 novelty 分析（`novelty_rankinstab.txt`, 7/10）明确说「若退化成 cheap margin/entropy/top1-gap 就是 CFPER, 新意很弱」——数据正落在此。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6879:它把旧问题“减小 visible-infrared modality gap”改写成“对共享特征做层级净化”。关键词是 hierarchical feature decoupling、feature purification、camera-modality-identity、camera-irrelated features、identity-related residual、redundant features、cross-modality recombination。这样一来，问题不再是单个模态对齐损失，而是先把相机干扰拿掉，再处理模态冗余，再把被归一化丢掉的身份信息补回来。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6882:机制和重定义绑定得很直接。第一层 CDM 用通道掩码把特征分成 camera-related 和 camera-irrelated，分别用相机标签、身份标签和对抗约束来分开。第二层 MIDM 对 camera-irrelated 特征做 IN，得到模态更稳定的特征，但承认 IN 会丢身份，于是把原特征和 IN 后特征的残差拿出来，再拆成正残差和负残差。正残差和归一化特征重组成身份特征，负残差重组成冗余特征。然后用 adversarial decoupling loss 让身份特征类内更紧、类间更远，让冗余特征相反。最后 FCRS 把同身份不同模态的正残差交叉重组，用中心约束进一步逼模型关注跨模态共享身份信息。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6933:机制也比较自然。为了不逐对比对，就仍然保留 ReID 的特征提取加相似度检索范式。为了用 LVLM 的语义理解能力，就用指令让 Qwen2-VL 针对行人图像生成一个 `<REID>` 语义 token，要求关注年龄、性别、衣着、生物特征。为了让这个 token 不只是孤立文本输出，设计 SGI，把语义 token 和视觉 tokens 拼起来经过 4 层 Transformer 交互，最后用强化后的语义 token 作为身份表示。为了处理相机变化，又加 camera semantic supplementation，最好的是把相机 embedding 加到视觉 patch embedding 上。训练用 ID loss 和 triplet loss，LLM 冻结但允许梯度穿过它更新视觉模型和 SGI。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6969:它把旧问题“减小 visible-infrared modality gap”改写成“对共享特征做层级净化”。关键词是 hierarchical feature decoupling、feature purification、camera-modality-identity、camera-irrelated features、identity-related residual、redundant features、cross-modality recombination。这样一来，问题不再是单个模态对齐损失，而是先把相机干扰拿掉，再处理模态冗余，再把被归一化丢掉的身份信息补回来。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6574:2. 重定义动作：他们把“伪标签有噪声”重定义成“相机诱导的结构性噪声”。这比随机噪声更好讲，因为它有稳定来源：背景、视角、光照和相机域。关键词是 `camera-induced label noise`、`camera-domain centroid`、`coarse-to-fine purification`、`structural gatekeeper`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6578:4. 证据闭环：它做得比较规范。除了组件消融，还用 ARI、inter-camera distance、跨模态匹配准确率和类内距离来证明“相机噪声真的被压下去了”。例如 CPC 后 ARI 提升，PGM 替换 OTPM 会掉点，去掉 NCL 后类内距离变大，去掉 NMU 后 memory 漂移带来性能下降。这些指标正好对应它重定义的噪声来源。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6602:4. 证据闭环：消融显示 DCAM、CATS、GSMEM、CARC 逐步涨，完整模型在 SYSU-MM01 到 68.52 Rank-1 和 64.0 mAP。更贴近重定义的是三类图：超参 p 证明闭环长度有效，检索可视化说明 partial modules 仍处理不好大姿态差，t-SNE 和距离分布显示跨模态聚合和类间分离逐步改善。但如果严审，“拓扑”本身是否比普通图传播更关键，还需要更强的 cycle-only 对照。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_1.md:10875:3. **机制怎么长出来**：机制基本是自然推出的。既然 2D 帧被遮挡和错位破坏，就用 SMPL/HMR 生成 3D mesh，转成 point cloud，再用 PointPillars 得到和 2D feature 对齐的 pseudo-image feature；CMF 用 deformable cross-attention 和 2D-3D 映射点做融合；SSTI 用 SMPL shape 参数建 spatial/temporal 两条注意力流，专门处理相似外观混淆。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_1.md:10877:4. **证据闭环**：它的证据链较完整。组件 ablation 显示 SSTI 对 appearance confusion 有贡献，CMF 对 frame-level feature 贡献更大；fusion strategy 对比证明不是随便 concat 3D 就行；SSTI 和 GRU/self-attention、空间/时间单流等变体对比证明“空间和时间 shape 交互”必要；t-SNE、Grad-CAM、hard occlusion feature map 展示模型确实更关注目标区域。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2097:./ondisk_pivot.md:2783:./debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2099:./ondisk_pivot.md:2790:./debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2100:./ondisk_pivot.md:2792:./debate/d_2.md:84:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2101:./ondisk_pivot.md:2793:./debate/d_2.md:92:   近年的 CA-Jaccard 明确指出 camera variation 会让 Jaccard/re-ranking 邻域被 intra-camera samples 主导，带来 intra-camera negatives、排除 inter-camera positives；它用 camera-aware k-reciprocal neighbor 和 local query expansion 修正。你的 D2 里同相机降权直接赢 hub penalty，说明 hubness 可能仍被 camera topology 解释/覆盖一部分。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2155:./ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4422:./debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4423:./debate/d_2.md:84:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4425:./debate/d_2.md:92:   近年的 CA-Jaccard 明确指出 camera variation 会让 Jaccard/re-ranking 邻域被 intra-camera samples 主导，带来 intra-camera negatives、排除 inter-camera positives；它用 camera-aware k-reciprocal neighbor 和 local query expansion 修正。你的 D2 里同相机降权直接赢 hub penalty，说明 hubness 可能仍被 camera topology 解释/覆盖一部分。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4433:./debate/d_2.md:136:   ReID 的 mAP 看的是多正样本整体排序。hub penalty 让 R1 `+1.13`，但 mAP 只 `+0.31` 且输给 k-reciprocal/camera，说明它可能只是把少数 false-top1 hub 压下去，没有系统性把所有 positives 拉上来。训练版也许能扩大这个效应，但当前证据更像“rank head repair”，不是“embedding 判别力提升”。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4439:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:159:2. 重定义动作：他们没有泛泛说“伪标签有噪声”，而是把噪声拆成三个更具体的问题：距离度量不懂相机，代理点不符合 DBSCAN 的局部密度结构，监督目标太硬。关键词是 dynamic adaptive camera Jaccard、manifold、medoid proxy、dynamic adaptive proxies、soft pseudo labels。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4463:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:883:2. **重定义动作**：他们把问题从“如何生成更好伪标签”改成“如何选择最有训练价值的 proxy 对”。关键词是 `optimal proxy mining`、`hardest camera proxy`、`false negative proxies mining`、`misaligned contrastive pairs`、`camera-constrained hard negative mining`、`anti-noise ranking`。这让创新点落在训练信号选择，而不是聚类算法本身。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4475:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1152:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4491:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1502:2. 重定义动作：他们把无监督 ReID 从“伪标签不准”重定义成“多相机子域之间缺少语义传播”。每个 camera 被定义成一个 domain，训练不只是 cluster contrastive learning，而是 camera-aware multi-domain adaptive learning。关键词是 camera-aware graph、multi-domain、semantic propagation、domain-invariant representation。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4496:./analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1669:4. 证据闭环：消融显示 DCAM、CATS、GSMEM、CARC 逐步涨，完整模型在 SYSU-MM01 到 68.52 Rank-1 和 64.0 mAP。更贴近重定义的是三类图：超参 p 证明闭环长度有效，检索可视化说明 partial modules 仍处理不好大姿态差，t-SNE 和距离分布显示跨模态聚合和类间分离逐步改善。但如果严审，“拓扑”本身是否比普通图传播更关键，还需要更强的 cycle-only 对照。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4506:./analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4521:./debate/d_1.md:86:Market 的 D2 mAP 弱不能过度解读。你们 Market 已经 94.6 mAP，headroom 极低；而 MSMT17 原论文明确设计成更大、更真实、更难，有 15 camera、复杂光照/场景、4101 IDs/126441 boxes。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.08565)) Occluded ReID 又天然有 missing/noisy information。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.04712)) 一个 2025 ReID re-ranking 结果也显示，邻域/拓扑类后处理在 MSMT17、Occluded-DukeMTMC 的 R1 增益远大于 Market。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.04050)) 这正支持“Market 看不出，难集会放大 hub 病”的判断。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4765:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:3:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5543:./reassess/r_2.md:892:analyses/deep_25.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：最强闭环是“换辅助模态”消融。dense correspondence embeddings 全面超过 2D keypoints、silhouettes、part segmentation、3D skeletons、point clouds、SMPL parameters，证明重定义的“稠密对齐表示比稀疏参数更适合”是对的。组件表里，appearance baseline 在 VCCR CC 是 49.7 rank-1、40.2 mAP，完整方法到 59.8、48.6；CCVID 从 80.9、75.3 到 93.9、91.2。MRIE 相比简单融合带来大幅提升，说明不是单纯 gait 分支有效，而是 gait-appearance interaction 有价值。ECS、PCA 可视化、t-SNE 和激活图进一步证明 dense correspondence embedding 稳定，3D gait 比 SMPL 参数更成簇，融合后类间更清楚。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5569:./reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5572:./reassess/r_2.md:1924:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5573:./reassess/r_2.md:1925:reassess/r_3.md:4498:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5643:./reassess/r_2.md:4307:reassess/r_2.md:1570:reassess/r_3.md:3430:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_14.md:2806:cheap kill-switch：不训练新大模型，先用现有 SMPL 或 2D joints 把图像分成若干 canonical 身体区域，用 SOLIDER 特征做 visibility-aware pooling 和距离重加权。若在 AG-ReID 小子集上最后指标没有超过普通全局特征至少 mAP 0.4、rank1 0.5，先杀掉。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5645:./reassess/r_2.md:4372:reassess/r_2.md:1756:reassess/r_3.md:3883:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview/reviews/lit_9.md:2891:of non-overlapping distributed cameras. In the early stages
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5646:./reassess/r_2.md:4416:reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5647:./reassess/r_2.md:4417:reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5648:./reassess/r_2.md:4419:reassess/r_2.md:1924:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5649:./reassess/r_2.md:4420:reassess/r_2.md:1925:reassess/r_3.md:4498:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:127:"novel_component": "Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS): turning an explainability signal into a re-ranking operator — measure how much the model's attention overlaps the visible-body mask (IoU) and how mutually consistent query/gallery attention maps are, then asymmetrically shrink or inflate pairwise distances. It makes \"is the model looking at occluded regions?\" a concrete, label-free matching correction rather than a post-hoc visualization.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5653:./reassess/r_2.md:4440:reassess/r_2.md:1991:reassess/r_3.md:4760:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:420:1. ⭐ **因果 backdoor-triplet**(搬 gait GaitC3I TIP25/GaitSCM CVIU24)：把 camera-id+occlusion-state 当显式混淆变量 C, backdoor adjustment 改 triplet 正样本采样, 让跨遮挡/跨摄像头正样本对不再发协变量差异冒充身份的有害梯度。仓库零因果/SCM 代码(唯一命中 DACHM/DACCM 是 training-free reranker, 另一 lever)。**唯一同时满足: 问题重定义+机制新+零代码+避所有已死框架**。遮挡状态从 pose 可见性直接得。0.5天无训练首验。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5693:./reassess/r_2.md:5827:reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5694:./reassess/r_2.md:5830:reassess/r_3.md:8002:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5695:./reassess/r_2.md:5832:reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11396:pivot/novelty_gopl.md:105:但它不是完全无人区。最大撞车面在 **VPM / PVPM / QPM 这条 visibility / shared-region / positive-pair correspondence 线**；所以 GOPL 不能讲成“首次用可见区域/共同可见部位处理 ReID”，只能讲成 **把几何共同可观测性从匹配/对齐模块，前移为 same-ID 正监督关系的可靠性度量与训练图构造原则**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11397:pivot/novelty_gopl.md:114:| (d) pose / visibility / co-visibility-aware ReID | 高风险局部撞车 | [VPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.00537) 已经按 shared visible regions 比较两图；[PVPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00230) 用 positive pairs 的 part correspondence + graph matching 自挖 visibility；[QPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.00107) 明确做 pair-wise common non-occluded regions；[High-Order Relation/Topology](https://arxiv.org/abs/2003.08177) 用 pose landmarks、图关系、对齐处理 occluded ReID。 | 这是最危险撞车区。GOPL 必须避开“共同可见部位匹配/对齐”叙事，改讲 **训练监督关系重定义**：SMPL overlap 不进入身份表征、不做 inference matching、不做 part alignment，只决定 same-ID positive edge 的可靠性、采样顺序和约束强度。 | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11398:pivot/novelty_gopl.md:116:| (f) graph-sampler / relation ReID | 存活 | [SGGNN](https://arxiv.org/abs/1807.09975) 建 probe-gallery relation graph；[GCT](https://arxiv.org/abs/1804.00242) 用 graph matching 做 correspondence transfer；[PVPM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00230) 也用 graph matching；[CLIP-DFGS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.11255) 用 graph sampler 做 hard sample mining。 | graph / sampler / relation 都不新。GOPL 要强调 graph 的边权来自 **SMPL 共同可见表面 overlap**，且图服务于 same-ID positive learning order，而不是检索时关系推理。 | 7/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:11399:pivot/novelty_gopl.md:121:1. **PVPM**：它已经用 positive pair 的 correspondence 和 graph matching 自挖 part visibility。杀伤最大，因为它同时碰到 positive pair、visibility、graph matching。区别是 PVPM 学 visibility/part matching，GOPL 学正边可靠性和训练图。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1066:./reviews/deep_28.md:6879:它把旧问题“减小 visible-infrared modality gap”改写成“对共享特征做层级净化”。关键词是 hierarchical feature decoupling、feature purification、camera-modality-identity、camera-irrelated features、identity-related residual、redundant features、cross-modality recombination。这样一来，问题不再是单个模态对齐损失，而是先把相机干扰拿掉，再处理模态冗余，再把被归一化丢掉的身份信息补回来。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1067:./reviews/deep_28.md:6882:机制和重定义绑定得很直接。第一层 CDM 用通道掩码把特征分成 camera-related 和 camera-irrelated，分别用相机标签、身份标签和对抗约束来分开。第二层 MIDM 对 camera-irrelated 特征做 IN，得到模态更稳定的特征，但承认 IN 会丢身份，于是把原特征和 IN 后特征的残差拿出来，再拆成正残差和负残差。正残差和归一化特征重组成身份特征，负残差重组成冗余特征。然后用 adversarial decoupling loss 让身份特征类内更紧、类间更远，让冗余特征相反。最后 FCRS 把同身份不同模态的正残差交叉重组，用中心约束进一步逼模型关注跨模态共享身份信息。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1181:./validate/v_3.md:204:**跨视角身份证据是"部分 token-set 匹配"问题, 不是"全局原型对齐"问题。** 航拍-地面单图在两视角下**无 1-1 部位对应**(俯视看头肩/平视看全身)。全局原型(OVP/CMPC)对"缺失区域"一律惩罚, 把不可对应的部分也算进相似度; **partial MaxSim 让"能对上的 token"承担相似度, 对不上的不拖累**——这正是 late-interaction 的 retrieval 语义, 契合跨视角证据稀疏/不对齐的本质。
