/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:2792:./debate/d_2.md:84:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:2799:./debate/d_2.md:124:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:3790:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:8:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:3801:./analyses/deep_9.txt:27:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然核心是可靠性，它先用多个 MLLM 生成候选描述，再用已有 TIReID 模型的图文相似度选择更可靠文本。然后只对图像聚类，把伪标签传给匹配文本，再用文本和图像类中心的相似度做 IQR 异常过滤。最后 MTJL 从类中心和实例两个层面收紧跨模态特征。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:3803:./analyses/deep_9.txt:29:5. reviewer 为什么买账：买的是问题分解。它没有简单说“大模型生成文本能用”，而是说无监督 TIReID 的难点在两层可靠性：图文关系可靠、伪身份可靠。novelty 来源是数据构造和可靠性过滤的闭环，机制和重定义绑定较紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:3811:./debate/clean/d_1.txt:4:文献侧支持“训练值得一试”。Hubness 本来就是高维 kNN/检索空间里的结构性问题，HAL 在 text-image matching 中明确用 local/global hub 统计和 memory bank 做训练端 hubness-aware loss，并报告 R@1 大幅提升；这说明“训练时改 embedding 分布”比事后惩罚分数有现实先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097)) NeighborRetr 也把 cross-modal retrieval 的 hubness 从 post-hoc normalization 推到 training-time balancing，并强调 bad hubs / good hubs 的区分。([github.com](https://github.com/zzezze/NeighborRetr))
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:3812:./debate/clean/d_1.txt:6:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4405:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4655:./reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4737:./reassess/r_3.md:8682:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4740:./reassess/r_3.md:8690:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4747:./reassess/r_3.md:8735:analyses/deep_15.txt:32:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4762:./reassess/r_3.md:8798:analyses/deep_25.txt:45:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5633:./analyses/deep_13.txt:4:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里大家都在学 modality-shared feature，但这样会丢掉一部分有判别力的 modality-specific 信息。已有补偿方法走图像生成，RGB 和 IR 互转太难，尤其 IR 生成可见光会带来颜色不一致等噪声，所以补偿线反而不如 shared feature 线。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5663:./analyses/deep_22.txt:57:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5930:在 RSTPReid 上找这种失败：文本描述很泛，例如黑衣、深色裤、背包，标准 text-image 排名把一堆语义相似人排前；但目标图像在 frozen SOLIDER image-image 空间里其实有清晰身份邻域。也就是：失败不是“局部图文没对齐”，而是**文本查询没有落到已有视觉身份流形的正确区域**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:5933:方法可叫 `RMA-TIReID`：ReID-Manifold Anchored Text-to-Image ReID。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:974:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/hubness_paper_review.md:73:Top-30 hub galleries vs camera-matched controls: hubs are brighter (140 vs 119), more colorful (18 vs 11), and a bright high-contrast scene (a parked orange car + brick plaza) is over-represented (~7–8/30 vs 0–1/30 base rate). /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1613:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1830:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6608:1. 触发观察：车辆 ReID 真实训练数据受隐私和标注成本限制，3D 引擎数据有域差，GAN 数据细粒度属性不稳定。车辆类内差异很小，前格栅、尾灯、车身类型、颜色错一点，合成数据就会误导训练。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1831:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6612:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果问题是属性一致性和真实域风格，就先建车辆属性 prompt 库；如果通用 diffusion 不贴近目标域，就用 1% 无标签真实图经 BLIP-2 生成 caption，再用 LoRA 方式微调 diffusion；如果生成图会多车、碎车、颜色错，就用 YOLO 裁车、CLIP 做颜色语义过滤；最后用 CE 和 circle loss 训练任意 ReID 模型。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1832:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6620:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1833:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6622:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1834:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6624:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1835:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6626:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1836:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6628:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1840:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6687:1. 触发观察：车辆 ReID 真实训练数据受隐私和标注成本限制，3D 引擎数据有域差，GAN 数据细粒度属性不稳定。车辆类内差异很小，前格栅、尾灯、车身类型、颜色错一点，合成数据就会误导训练。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3144:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2894:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:990:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3148:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:2941:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1162:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3154:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3002:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1453:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 过去常把跨模态差异当作要消除的东西，结果共享对齐会丢掉可见光颜色纹理、红外热特征这些细节；生成式补偿又会引入噪声或依赖辅助模型。BDLF 论文页面也明确把缺口说成“只挖 shared，忽略 modality-specific details”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03286))
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3162:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3055:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1687:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3163:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3056:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1689:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3164:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3057:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1691:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3165:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3058:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1693:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3166:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3059:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1695:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3168:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3093:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1816:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:3170:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3098:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1833:1. 触发观察：作者抓到的是“对齐会伤判别性”。VI-ReID 里大家都在缩小可见光和红外的模态差异，但直接做分布对齐会把不同身份也拉近，颜色、纹理等细粒度线索也被洗掉。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5111:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6608:1. 触发观察：车辆 ReID 真实训练数据受隐私和标注成本限制，3D 引擎数据有域差，GAN 数据细粒度属性不稳定。车辆类内差异很小，前格栅、尾灯、车身类型、颜色错一点，合成数据就会误导训练。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5112:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6612:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果问题是属性一致性和真实域风格，就先建车辆属性 prompt 库；如果通用 diffusion 不贴近目标域，就用 1% 无标签真实图经 BLIP-2 生成 caption，再用 LoRA 方式微调 diffusion；如果生成图会多车、碎车、颜色错，就用 YOLO 裁车、CLIP 做颜色语义过滤；最后用 CE 和 circle loss 训练任意 ReID 模型。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5113:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6620:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5114:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6622:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5115:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6624:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5116:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6626:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5117:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6628:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5122:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6687:1. 触发观察：车辆 ReID 真实训练数据受隐私和标注成本限制，3D 引擎数据有域差，GAN 数据细粒度属性不稳定。车辆类内差异很小，前格栅、尾灯、车身类型、颜色错一点，合成数据就会误导训练。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5123:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6691:3. 机制怎么长出来：如果问题是属性一致性和真实域风格，就先建车辆属性 prompt 库；如果通用 diffusion 不贴近目标域，就用 1% 无标签真实图经 BLIP-2 生成 caption，再用 LoRA 方式微调 diffusion；如果生成图会多车、碎车、颜色错，就用 YOLO 裁车、CLIP 做颜色语义过滤；最后用 CE 和 circle loss 训练任意 ReID 模型。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5124:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6699:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5125:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6701:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5126:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6703:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5127:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6705:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5128:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_6.md:6707:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5799:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2100:./ondisk_pivot.md:2792:./debate/d_2.md:84:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5826:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2142:./ondisk_pivot.md:3790:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:8:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:5827:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2145:./ondisk_pivot.md:3812:./debate/clean/d_1.txt:6:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7808:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:14391: 11313	3. **机制怎么长出来**：ESFA 用 LLaVA 给可见光和红外图像生成描述，在各自模态内做图文对齐。CSIA 不直接强拉图像和异模态文本，而是约束“模态内图文相似度”和“跨模态文本相似度”一致，绕开颜色冲突。CVSC 用同身份其他视角文本补偿当前文本，把一对一图文匹配扩成一对多语义对齐。机制和重定义绑定非常紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7812:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:626:./reviews/deep_8.md:12135:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7815:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:645:./reviews/deep_8.md:12182:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7816:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:697:./reviews/deep_19.md:8963:1. 触发观察：作者注意到换衣 ReID 里单一线索都不可靠。RGB 外观会被衣服误导，mask 或 silhouette 丢掉颜色、脸部和配饰等有用线索，身体局部裁剪又会受背景和局部噪声影响。简单拼接多个特征也不够，因为不同特征权重固定，空间语义也未对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7817:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:711:./reviews/deep_19.md:9040:1. 触发观察：作者注意到换衣 ReID 里单一线索都不可靠。RGB 外观会被衣服误导，mask 或 silhouette 丢掉颜色、脸部和配饰等有用线索，身体局部裁剪又会受背景和局部噪声影响。简单拼接多个特征也不够，因为不同特征权重固定，空间语义也未对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7821:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:848:./validate_candidates.sh:19:ROLES[2]="你的角色=**红队辩护**。为候选 B 辩护它是最强 B 类赌注: 用联网把它和 PDA/OT-ReID/probabilistic-embedding 的**切开点**打磨锋利(我们是 cross-VIEW 不是 text-image; 非对称方向航拍⊆地面由**成像物理**定不是纯视觉cost)。设计**最能打动 reviewer 的杀手级证据**(哪个消融/可视化/诊断指标一旦失败就推翻叙事)。再判断这个 idea 够不够一篇 B 类的体量。务实中文, 给信心分 1-10 + 证据设计。"
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7829:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:944:./reviews/deep_15.md:8496:EAIBC 的前 8 页覆盖了完整方法：观察来自检索失败样例和 RGB/灰度响应图差异，机制是四分支互学。还要补它的颜色分支和互学习优化段落，随后可以进入综合拆解。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7831:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:953:./reviews/deep_15.md:13772:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7834:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:956:./reviews/deep_15.md:13785:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7835:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:957:./reviews/deep_15.md:13786:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“跨模态对齐不够好”改成“颜色过度依赖导致模型忽略纹理、结构和局部物品”。关键词是 `color over-reliance`、`all-round information beyond color`、`grayscale branch`、`high-frequency branch`、`color branch`、`mutual learning`。大家以为颜色是最强线索要强化，其实颜色太强会遮蔽其他可判别线索。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7856:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1257:./analyses/deep_12.txt:26:**触发观察：** 文本到图像 ReID 的对比学习默认“非配对样本都是负样本”。作者指出这个假设在 TIReID 里不成立，因为文本描述可能适配多个行人，标注或描述粒度也会造成语义相近的假负样本。把这些样本推远会破坏跨模态对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7864:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1392:./reviews/deep_9.md:6899:1. 触发观察：作者抓到的是“对齐会伤判别性”。VI-ReID 里大家都在缩小可见光和红外的模态差异，但直接做分布对齐会把不同身份也拉近，颜色、纹理等细粒度线索也被洗掉。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7868:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1403:./reviews/deep_9.md:6924:5. reviewer 为什么买账：买的是问题分解。它没有简单说“大模型生成文本能用”，而是说无监督 TIReID 的难点在两层可靠性：图文关系可靠、伪身份可靠。novelty 来源是数据构造和可靠性过滤的闭环，机制和重定义绑定较紧。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7884:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:1883:./reviews/deep_25.md:14075:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7929:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3002:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1453:1. 触发观察：VI-ReID 过去常把跨模态差异当作要消除的东西，结果共享对齐会丢掉可见光颜色纹理、红外热特征这些细节；生成式补偿又会引入噪声或依赖辅助模型。BDLF 论文页面也明确把缺口说成“只挖 shared，忽略 modality-specific details”。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.03286))
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7936:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3055:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1687:1. 触发观察：现实里嫌疑人检索可能同时有文字描述和素描，但现有方法多按 Text-RGB、Sketch-RGB 成对对齐。作者进一步统计属性覆盖：RGB 信息最全，text 有颜色和粗语义但缺轮廓，sketch 有轮廓和姿态但缺颜色和纹理。直接投到共同空间会造成语义歧义。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7937:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3056:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1689:2. 重定义动作：它把跨模态 ReID 从“缩小模态差距”重定义为“建立公平属性空间”。也就是说，不同模态不是噪声不同，而是属性缺失不同。关键词是 `attribute fairness`、`auxiliary color sketch`、`attribute compensation`、`modality-agnostic`、`unified collaborative alignment`。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7938:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3057:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1691:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 text 和 sketch 都缺属性，就生成一个同时含轮廓、颜色、纹理的 color sketch 作为桥。CSG 先做动态光照修正，再用 DoG 抽轮廓，并在 YUV 空间把轮廓放到亮度通道、颜色放到色度通道。ACRM 用 dissimilarity 找缺失信息并补偿，再用 photo-query dissimilarity 去掉辅助模态引入的噪声。UCA 再用身份保持、内容一致、三向结构约束和类内紧致损失统一对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7939:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3058:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1693:4. 证据闭环：它的消融正好围绕“属性公平”展开。彩色 sketch 相比黑白 sketch 在 text、sketch、text+sketch 三种任务都涨；AC 单独补属性有效，RF 去噪后继续涨；UCA 的各个损失逐步加入也有增益；t-SNE 显示 color sketch 把 sketch 和 photo 拉近。这些证据不是只证明模块有效，而是在证明“补属性再对齐”比直接对齐更合理。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7940:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3059:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1695:5. reviewer 为什么买账：这篇卖的是视角。它把统一多模态检索讲成“缺失属性补偿问题”，而不是多个任务共享 backbone。novelty 真正来源是 auxiliary color sketch 这个桥接媒介，以及“先补偿再对齐”的逻辑。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7944:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3093:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1816:3. 机制怎么长出来：既然 RGB 文本偏颜色，灰度图可以弱化颜色并突出体型、姿态，就自然推出 `MDG` 同时生成 RGB 和灰度伪文本；既然两种文本各有偏向，就用 `HSF` 同时约束视觉特征；`VSS` 的 ResNet+ViT 融合是补强视觉编码，和核心重定义的绑定不如 MDG/HSF 紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7945:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3098:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1833:1. 触发观察：作者抓到的是“对齐会伤判别性”。VI-ReID 里大家都在缩小可见光和红外的模态差异，但直接做分布对齐会把不同身份也拉近，颜色、纹理等细粒度线索也被洗掉。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7949:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:3109:../litreview2/analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1858:5. reviewer 为什么买账：买的是问题分解。它没有简单说“大模型生成文本能用”，而是说无监督 TIReID 的难点在两层可靠性：图文关系可靠、伪身份可靠。novelty 来源是数据构造和可靠性过滤的闭环，机制和重定义绑定较紧。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:7956:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_3.md:4042:../litreview/reviews/lit_15.md:4220:创新类型是新机制加新语义设定。gap 是 VI-ReID 的 CLIP prompt 往往未知、粗糙、两阶段，而且可见光和红外描述中会有冲突语义，比如颜色。它用 LLaVA 生成显式文本，用间接相似度约束处理跨模态冲突，再融合多视角文本。story 是“语义空间没有模态差，但必须用显式、多视角、可处理冲突的语义来对齐”。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8891:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/HUBNESS_PAPER_DRAFT.md:40:Top-30 hub galleries vs camera-matched controls: hubs are brighter (140 vs 119), more colorful (18 vs 11), and a bright high-contrast scene (a parked orange car + brick plaza) is over-represented (~7–8/30 vs 0–1/30 base rate). Critically, the 30 hubs span **24 distinct identities** yet cluster with mean pairwise cosine **0.166** (control 0.025); each hub's 10-NN contains 26.7% other top-1% hubs (27× the 1% base rate). The model groups unrelated identities by a **shared non-identity factor**—the scene—producing the cross-ID attraction. (All replicated within camera-0 to exclude camera confound.)

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14304:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2663:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2550:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_1.md:84:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:1984:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reviews/deep_25.md:14083:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

However, these cues become unreliable under aerial viewpoints
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2632:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2441:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:84:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2642:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2457:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:124:   HAL 确实在 text-image matching 里提出 hubness-aware loss，用 memory bank/global-local statistics 给 hubs 加权，并报告 MS-COCO/Flickr30k R@1 提升；但它比较的是 Sum/Max ranking loss，不是 person ReID 的 k-reciprocal/camera-aware re-ranking。NeighborRetr 也明确说跨模态里已有 HAL、Dual Softmax、QB-Norm、DBNorm 等路线，并且 HAL 这种“放大 hub loss”的策略可能惩罚 beneficial hubs，需要区分 good/bad hubs。来源：HAL 方法描述和结果、NeighborRetr related work。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2662:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2549:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_1.md:82:文献侧支持“训练值得一试”。Hubness 本来就是高维 kNN/检索空间里的结构性问题，HAL 在 text-image matching 中明确用 local/global hub 统计和 memory bank 做训练端 hubness-aware loss，并报告 R@1 大幅提升；这说明“训练时改 embedding 分布”比事后惩罚分数有现实先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097)) NeighborRetr 也把 cross-modal retrieval 的 hubness 从 post-hoc normalization 推到 training-time balancing，并强调 bad hubs / good hubs 的区分。([github.com](https://github.com/zzezze/NeighborRetr))
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2663:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2550:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_1.md:84:这不等于撞车。HAL 是 text-image matching，NeighborRetr 是 cross-modal retrieval；你们的切口是 **same-modality person ReID 的 gallery 负向 in-degree / many-query-to-one false attraction**。ReID 里的经典 k-reciprocal 是 test-time re-ranking：用 reciprocal neighbors 编 Jaccard，再和原距离融合，不产生部署用的单 embedding。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398)) Person ReID 文献也长期把“学 embedding”和“再 re-rank”当互补步骤，PSE/ECN 明确同时贡献 learned representation 和 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.10378)) 所以 anti-hub embedding 的价值不是赢过 k-reciprocal 的 mAP，而是得到一个 **不用 re-rank 的更好单向量**，再看能否与 re-rank 叠加。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2667:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2560:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_1.md:116:文献侧支持“训练值得一试”。Hubness 本来就是高维 kNN/检索空间里的结构性问题，HAL 在 text-image matching 中明确用 local/global hub 统计和 memory bank 做训练端 hubness-aware loss，并报告 R@1 大幅提升；这说明“训练时改 embedding 分布”比事后惩罚分数有现实先例。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1911.10097)) NeighborRetr 也把 cross-modal retrieval 的 hubness 从 post-hoc normalization 推到 training-time balancing，并强调 bad hubs / good hubs 的区分。([github.com](https://github.com/zzezze/NeighborRetr))

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:4407:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/validate/v_2.md:7085:analyses/deep_25.txt:53:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:186:./analyses/deep_13.txt:4:1. **触发观察**：VI-ReID 里大家都在学 modality-shared feature，但这样会丢掉一部分有判别力的 modality-specific 信息。已有补偿方法走图像生成，RGB 和 IR 互转太难，尤其 IR 生成可见光会带来颜色不一致等噪声，所以补偿线反而不如 shared feature 线。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5032:analyses/deep_13.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：采样对比显示 CGS 好于 random、PK、cluster，并且比已有 GS 快很多，Market 上采样 0.1 秒对 4 秒，MSMT(all) 上 1 秒对 40 秒。CGS 相比 Cluster 在 Market 到 CUHK03 上提升约 3.0 Rank-1 和 2.8 mAP，在 Market 到 MSMT17 上提升约 3.9 和 2.9。CGS、GRSR、GSANet 的组合消融显示完整模型最好。采样可视化证明 CGS 找到衣服颜色、局部外观相近的邻近类别。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5043:reviews/deep_8.md:12133:1. 触发观察：CCReID 里视觉外观被衣服强烈污染，传统方法容易困在视觉瓶颈；但直接用 CLIP 也有问题，因为 CLIP 生成或学习的文本往往偏向衣服颜色，而衣服颜色在换衣场景不稳定。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5045:reviews/deep_8.md:12180:1. 触发观察：CCReID 里视觉外观被衣服强烈污染，传统方法容易困在视觉瓶颈；但直接用 CLIP 也有问题，因为 CLIP 生成或学习的文本往往偏向衣服颜色，而衣服颜色在换衣场景不稳定。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5343:reviews/deep_15.md:13764:1. **触发观察**：作者看到 CC-ReID 里很多方法只是在衣服区域做颜色扰动、外观重建或粗粒度人体组件分解，但真实人有身高、体型、纹理结构和局部相关性。直接重建或通道切分容易丢掉原始样本里的身份信息，还会把背景轮廓等非身份噪声当成有用线索。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5345:reviews/deep_15.md:13766:3. **机制怎么长出来**：NWMP 用非局部加权感知建模不同人体区域之间的关系，DPLS 用 2×2 和 4×4 池化做局部到整体的多尺度学习。PRE 则用人体结构把重建分成头部、身体、下肢，并引入 clothing parsing，从通道、位置和颜色角度得到更稳定的人体轮廓和衣服无关特征。整体损失把 ID、衣服分类对抗、重建、解析和多分类损失合在一起。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5348:reviews/deep_15.md:13772:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5352:reviews/deep_15.md:13785:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5353:reviews/deep_15.md:13788:4. **证据闭环**：这篇证据很完整。先用检索失败样例和 RGB/GRS response maps 证明颜色过度依赖存在。消融证明单分支不如多分支，加入 CLR branch 和 mutual learning 后更好。feature response map 显示 RGB 分支看粉色衣服，GRS 分支看自行车、包、箱子等非颜色线索。检索例子说明 EAIBC 能把颜色相似但细节不符的人往后排。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5358:reviews/deep_15.md:13811:1. **触发观察**：作者看到 CC-ReID 里很多方法只是在衣服区域做颜色扰动、外观重建或粗粒度人体组件分解，但真实人有身高、体型、纹理结构和局部相关性。直接重建或通道切分容易丢掉原始样本里的身份信息，还会把背景轮廓等非身份噪声当成有用线索。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5542:reviews/deep_19.md:8963:1. 触发观察：作者注意到换衣 ReID 里单一线索都不可靠。RGB 外观会被衣服误导，mask 或 silhouette 丢掉颜色、脸部和配饰等有用线索，身体局部裁剪又会受背景和局部噪声影响。简单拼接多个特征也不够，因为不同特征权重固定，空间语义也未对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:5547:reviews/deep_19.md:8981:4. 证据闭环：消融很对题。baseline 加 clothing adversarial attribute 后提升，说明压制衣服属性有效；加 identity-relevant attribute 后继续提升，说明保留稳定属性有效；再加 caption-level 约束提升，说明多粒度文本不是摆设；masked branch 的属性解耦去掉后也下降，说明擦衣服后仍有残留衣服语义。检索可视化显示 baseline 受颜色和款式影响更重，MAPL 更能跨衣服找人。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:6418:reviews/deep_21.md:7697:1. **触发观察**：USL ReID 大多用全局特征聚类生成伪标签，但全局特征会偏向最显眼外观，遇到衣服颜色相似、局部细节不同的人容易混。已有局部特征方法又常把局部特征单独聚类或单独监督，忽略全局和局部的互补。作者还指出一个更细的问题：伪类别内部也有噪声，会把类中心拉偏。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:6772:reviews/deep_28.md:6936:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7250:reviews/deep_20.md:6388:1. 触发观察：遮挡 ReID 里车辆遮挡很常见，论文说 Occluded-Duke query 中 vehicle-induced occlusion 占比超过 40%，但车辆图像通常被当成无关噪声丢掉。作者反过来观察到，车辆图像有真实纹理、颜色、视角和相机偏置，而且很容易从车牌系统收集。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7253:reviews/deep_20.md:6394:4. 证据闭环：他们做了 ENI only、INI only、ENI+INI 的组件消融，结果显示 INI 单独贡献最大，说明核心不是周期训练，而是真实车辆遮挡模拟。还和 MixUp、CutMix、Hide-and-Seek、GridMask、color jitter 比较，证明不是普通增广。再加 ENI 间隔、INI 高度比例、车辆分辨率、池化类型和推理速度消融，闭环是在证明“车辆作为结构化遮挡源”比随机遮挡和通用增广更对题。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7728:analyses/deep_19.txt:29:1. 触发观察：作者注意到换衣 ReID 里单一线索都不可靠。RGB 外观会被衣服误导，mask 或 silhouette 丢掉颜色、脸部和配饰等有用线索，身体局部裁剪又会受背景和局部噪声影响。简单拼接多个特征也不够，因为不同特征权重固定，空间语义也未对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7733:analyses/deep_19.txt:47:4. 证据闭环：消融很对题。baseline 加 clothing adversarial attribute 后提升，说明压制衣服属性有效；加 identity-relevant attribute 后继续提升，说明保留稳定属性有效；再加 caption-level 约束提升，说明多粒度文本不是摆设；masked branch 的属性解耦去掉后也下降，说明擦衣服后仍有残留衣服语义。检索可视化显示 baseline 受颜色和款式影响更重，MAPL 更能跨衣服找人。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7898:analyses/deep_15.txt:11:1. **触发观察**：作者看到 CC-ReID 里很多方法只是在衣服区域做颜色扰动、外观重建或粗粒度人体组件分解，但真实人有身高、体型、纹理结构和局部相关性。直接重建或通道切分容易丢掉原始样本里的身份信息，还会把背景轮廓等非身份噪声当成有用线索。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7900:analyses/deep_15.txt:13:3. **机制怎么长出来**：NWMP 用非局部加权感知建模不同人体区域之间的关系，DPLS 用 2×2 和 4×4 池化做局部到整体的多尺度学习。PRE 则用人体结构把重建分成头部、身体、下肢，并引入 clothing parsing，从通道、位置和颜色角度得到更稳定的人体轮廓和衣服无关特征。整体损失把 ID、衣服分类对抗、重建、解析和多分类损失合在一起。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7903:analyses/deep_15.txt:19:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7907:analyses/deep_15.txt:32:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7908:analyses/deep_15.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：这篇证据很完整。先用检索失败样例和 RGB/GRS response maps 证明颜色过度依赖存在。消融证明单分支不如多分支，加入 CLR branch 和 mutual learning 后更好。feature response map 显示 RGB 分支看粉色衣服，GRS 分支看自行车、包、箱子等非颜色线索。检索例子说明 EAIBC 能把颜色相似但细节不符的人往后排。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7916:analyses/deep_7.txt:35:4. 证据闭环：Table III 显示去掉 SMR 后 PRCC cloth-changing 从 65.5/63.0 掉到 57.8/55.8，local mining 和 refinement 各自也有贡献。Table IV 证明只用 content、只用 salient、简单串联或简单并联都不如 cross-parallel collaboration。Fig.3 检索可视化说明 baseline 被相似颜色和衣服纹理误导，而 CSSC 能靠身体、局部形状、鞋裤等语义找回。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7970:analyses/deep_25.txt:45:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:7988:analyses/deep_21.txt:41:1. **触发观察**：USL ReID 大多用全局特征聚类生成伪标签，但全局特征会偏向最显眼外观，遇到衣服颜色相似、局部细节不同的人容易混。已有局部特征方法又常把局部特征单独聚类或单独监督，忽略全局和局部的互补。作者还指出一个更细的问题：伪类别内部也有噪声，会把类中心拉偏。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8030:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:326:4. **证据闭环**：采样对比显示 CGS 好于 random、PK、cluster，并且比已有 GS 快很多，Market 上采样 0.1 秒对 4 秒，MSMT(all) 上 1 秒对 40 秒。CGS 相比 Cluster 在 Market 到 CUHK03 上提升约 3.0 Rank-1 和 2.8 mAP，在 Market 到 MSMT17 上提升约 3.9 和 2.9。CGS、GRSR、GSANet 的组合消融显示完整模型最好。采样可视化证明 CGS 找到衣服颜色、局部外观相近的邻近类别。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8043:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:396:1. **触发观察**：作者看到 CC-ReID 里很多方法只是在衣服区域做颜色扰动、外观重建或粗粒度人体组件分解，但真实人有身高、体型、纹理结构和局部相关性。直接重建或通道切分容易丢掉原始样本里的身份信息，还会把背景轮廓等非身份噪声当成有用线索。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8045:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:398:3. **机制怎么长出来**：NWMP 用非局部加权感知建模不同人体区域之间的关系，DPLS 用 2×2 和 4×4 池化做局部到整体的多尺度学习。PRE 则用人体结构把重建分成头部、身体、下肢，并引入 clothing parsing，从通道、位置和颜色角度得到更稳定的人体轮廓和衣服无关特征。整体损失把 ID、衣服分类对抗、重建、解析和多分类损失合在一起。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8048:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:404:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8063:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:445:1. 触发观察：草图能表达轮廓和结构，但表达不了颜色、性别、衣服语义等高层意图。已有 sketch+text 方法把草图和文本简单组合，既有模态干扰，又依赖昂贵的三模态数据。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8070:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:477:1. 触发观察：可见红外两种模态的有效身份线索大小和位置不一致，可能是全局衣服颜色、局部姿态，也可能是鞋子或脸部这类很小区域。单一全局或单一部位粒度会造成 irrelevant matching 和 ambiguous alignment。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8090:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:646:1. 触发观察：作者注意到换衣 ReID 里单一线索都不可靠。RGB 外观会被衣服误导，mask 或 silhouette 丢掉颜色、脸部和配饰等有用线索，身体局部裁剪又会受背景和局部噪声影响。简单拼接多个特征也不够，因为不同特征权重固定，空间语义也未对齐。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8095:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:664:4. 证据闭环：消融很对题。baseline 加 clothing adversarial attribute 后提升，说明压制衣服属性有效；加 identity-relevant attribute 后继续提升，说明保留稳定属性有效；再加 caption-level 约束提升，说明多粒度文本不是摆设；masked branch 的属性解耦去掉后也下降，说明擦衣服后仍有残留衣服语义。检索可视化显示 baseline 受颜色和款式影响更重，MAPL 更能跨衣服找人。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8109:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:840:1. 触发观察：遮挡 ReID 里车辆遮挡很常见，论文说 Occluded-Duke query 中 vehicle-induced occlusion 占比超过 40%，但车辆图像通常被当成无关噪声丢掉。作者反过来观察到，车辆图像有真实纹理、颜色、视角和相机偏置，而且很容易从车牌系统收集。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8112:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:846:4. 证据闭环：他们做了 ENI only、INI only、ENI+INI 的组件消融，结果显示 INI 单独贡献最大，说明核心不是周期训练，而是真实车辆遮挡模拟。还和 MixUp、CutMix、Hide-and-Seek、GridMask、color jitter 比较，证明不是普通增广。再加 ENI 间隔、INI 高度比例、车辆分辨率、池化类型和推理速度消融，闭环是在证明“车辆作为结构化遮挡源”比随机遮挡和通用增广更对题。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8117:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:893:1. **触发观察**：USL ReID 大多用全局特征聚类生成伪标签，但全局特征会偏向最显眼外观，遇到衣服颜色相似、局部细节不同的人容易混。已有局部特征方法又常把局部特征单独聚类或单独监督，忽略全局和局部的互补。作者还指出一个更细的问题：伪类别内部也有噪声，会把类中心拉偏。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8167:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1321:4. 证据闭环：消融 TEM、TAM、IAM 是基本证据，检索可视化说明局部错配减少。但从“well-posedness”这个概念看，最强证据应该是极端天气、强遮挡、颜色污染子集上的鲁棒性分析；论文主要用三数据集和定性图支撑，闭环不算特别强。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:8169:analyses/ALL_ANALYSES.txt:1409:关键消融是三组。第一，只用 LVLM 的 visual model 做 baseline 效果低，说明单纯视觉 tokens 不够。第二，把 LVLM 生成的 semantic token 换成随机 learnable token 后明显掉点，说明 `<REID>` token 的语义来源有用，不只是多了一个 class token。第三，去掉 SGI 后效果也掉，说明 token 需要和视觉 tokens 交互，而不是直接拿生成 token 检索。CSS 的消融显示把相机语义放到输入 patch embedding 比放到 `<REID>` token 后面更好，说明相机偏移要早处理。检索可视化显示 baseline 容易被颜色、衣服、姿态误导，而语义 token 引导后能抓住图案、配饰和遮挡下的细节。推理时间从 784ms 到 906ms 处理 64 张图，用来缓解“LVLM 太慢”的质疑。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8682:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8690:1. **触发观察**：TBPS 数据少，原因是隐私和文本标注成本高。已有增强要么靠大规模外部数据和 MLLM 预训练，要么靠 diffusion 编辑图像，成本高，还追求视觉真实但不一定提高检索。作者还观察到传统 re-ranking 的 k-reciprocal 假设在文本到图像里不成立，因为文本特征没有稳定的同模态局部邻域，text-image 距离分布也不平衡。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8728:analyses/deep_15.txt:13:3. **机制怎么长出来**：NWMP 用非局部加权感知建模不同人体区域之间的关系，DPLS 用 2×2 和 4×4 池化做局部到整体的多尺度学习。PRE 则用人体结构把重建分成头部、身体、下肢，并引入 clothing parsing，从通道、位置和颜色角度得到更稳定的人体轮廓和衣服无关特征。整体损失把 ID、衣服分类对抗、重建、解析和多分类损失合在一起。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8731:analyses/deep_15.txt:19:2. **重定义动作**：它把问题从“学习衣服无关特征”改成“在衣服相关区域中解耦身份相关信息”。关键词是 `identity-aware feature decoupling`、`ID-based knowledge transfer`、`clothing bias diminishing`、`clothing contrastive loss`。大家以为衣服区域要被抑制，其实衣服区域里还藏着体型、轮廓等身份线索，关键是别让颜色纹理主导。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8735:analyses/deep_15.txt:32:1. **触发观察**：作者先展示了文本行人检索的典型失败：错误结果排在前面，不是因为整体更像，而是颜色对上了。比如文本写“blue t-shirt”，目标其实是很浅的蓝，模型却召回一堆明显蓝色衣服的人。RGB 和灰度模型的响应图也显示它们关注不同区域。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8736:analyses/deep_15.txt:35:4. **证据闭环**：这篇证据很完整。先用检索失败样例和 RGB/GRS response maps 证明颜色过度依赖存在。消融证明单分支不如多分支，加入 CLR branch 和 mutual learning 后更好。feature response map 显示 RGB 分支看粉色衣服，GRS 分支看自行车、包、箱子等非颜色线索。检索例子说明 EAIBC 能把颜色相似但细节不符的人往后排。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8744:analyses/deep_7.txt:35:4. 证据闭环：Table III 显示去掉 SMR 后 PRCC cloth-changing 从 65.5/63.0 掉到 57.8/55.8，local mining 和 refinement 各自也有贡献。Table IV 证明只用 content、只用 salient、简单串联或简单并联都不如 cross-parallel collaboration。Fig.3 检索可视化说明 baseline 被相似颜色和衣服纹理误导，而 CSSC 能靠身体、局部形状、鞋裤等语义找回。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8798:analyses/deep_25.txt:45:3. **机制怎么长出来**：ATG 用 BLIP 问答和固定模板生成属性文本，并刻意避开颜色，保留 age、gender、action、clothing type、hair、glasses 这些更跨模态的属性。CTP 用 SCHP 人体解析去掉衣服区域，保留 body shape 和 pose 相关区域，再用可学习 prompt 表示 contour-aware class text。TRM 负责把 instance-level attribute text 和 class-level contour prompt 融成 image-aware redefined text，最后做 class-level text prototype，指导 RGB 和 IR visual feature 对齐。机制和“属性语义加结构语义”的问题定义是匹配的，但整体偏组合式。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8816:analyses/deep_21.txt:41:1. **触发观察**：USL ReID 大多用全局特征聚类生成伪标签，但全局特征会偏向最显眼外观，遇到衣服颜色相似、局部细节不同的人容易混。已有局部特征方法又常把局部特征单独聚类或单独监督，忽略全局和局部的互补。作者还指出一个更细的问题：伪类别内部也有噪声，会把类中心拉偏。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:5:> **GOPL**：SMPL 共同可见表面 overlap 只当 **same-ID positive edge 的可靠性度量**——高 overlap 早期强拉、低 overlap 延迟/弱约束/桥接。SMPL **不进身份表征、不做推理匹配、不做 part alignment、不做增广**（绕开 exp333 SMPL-β≈random + VPM/QPM/visibility 红海 + GSAlign/ViSA aerial-ground 红海）。

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5569:./reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5572:./reassess/r_2.md:1924:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5577:./reassess/r_2.md:1991:reassess/r_3.md:4760:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:420:1. ⭐ **因果 backdoor-triplet**(搬 gait GaitC3I TIP25/GaitSCM CVIU24)：把 camera-id+occlusion-state 当显式混淆变量 C, backdoor adjustment 改 triplet 正样本采样, 让跨遮挡/跨摄像头正样本对不再发协变量差异冒充身份的有害梯度。仓库零因果/SCM 代码(唯一命中 DACHM/DACCM 是 training-free reranker, 另一 lever)。**唯一同时满足: 问题重定义+机制新+零代码+避所有已死框架**。遮挡状态从 pose 可见性直接得。0.5天无训练首验。

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5647:./reassess/r_2.md:4417:reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5648:./reassess/r_2.md:4419:reassess/r_2.md:1924:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. Speciﬁcally, compared to the occlusion augmentation method FED [30], which requires additional computation to simulate occlusion data, our proposed method still shows
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5938:./reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5939:./reassess/r_3.md:8002:./reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5940:./reassess/r_3.md:8007:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5941:./reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4187:./reassess/r_3.md:2849:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4399:./reassess/r_3.md:4481:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:14:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adapt the VCS \"corrupt-a-parsed-region + feature-consistency loss\" trick to occlusion: use human parsing (or an occluder mask) to identify non-target/occluded regions, synthesize occlusion by replacing those pixels with random pixels sampled from a per-batch pool, then add an L2/MSE alignment loss pulling the corrupted-image feature toward the clean-image feature. This is a training-only, self-supervised occlusion-augmentation regularizer that teaches the backbone to produce features invariant to corrupted/missing regions, without needing extra inference modules or pose at test time. The batch-pool pixel-shuffle (rather than zero/black masking) is the transferable detail — it injects realistic distractor texture instead of constant fills, which better mimics real occluders.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4400:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4401:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4402:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4403:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4405:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4406:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4623:./reassess/r_3.md:7862:./reassess/r_3.md:2849:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。
