/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4634:./reassess/r_3.md:7897:./reassess/r_3.md:3334:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:23:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4635:./reassess/r_3.md:7901:./reassess/r_3.md:3351:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:1785:主文档确认了一个关键背景：遮挡方向已有大量“补全、可见性、结构关系、masking、metric alignment”负结果，且 exp109 一类结论确实在说可实现的遮挡处理很容易退化成 identity-conditioned oracle 不可达。现在我会专门检索本地 GOPL、source-separation、occluder-gate 相关材料，再做外部 novelty 对照。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4649:./reassess/r_3.md:7993:./reassess/r_3.md:4481:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:14:"transfer_to_occluded": "Adapt the VCS \"corrupt-a-parsed-region + feature-consistency loss\" trick to occlusion: use human parsing (or an occluder mask) to identify non-target/occluded regions, synthesize occlusion by replacing those pixels with random pixels sampled from a per-batch pool, then add an L2/MSE alignment loss pulling the corrupted-image feature toward the clean-image feature. This is a training-only, self-supervised occlusion-augmentation regularizer that teaches the backbone to produce features invariant to corrupted/missing regions, without needing extra inference modules or pose at test time. The batch-pool pixel-shuffle (rather than zero/black masking) is the transferable detail — it injects realistic distractor texture instead of constant fills, which better mimics real occluders.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4650:./reassess/r_3.md:7994:./reassess/r_3.md:4482:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:21:"mechanism": "TTPM is a ViT + HRNet pipeline with three parts and no occlusion-sample augmentation. A Multi-patch Feature Encoder encodes intra-patch and inter-patch features (re-grouping patches at 2x scale with the cls token). Pose-Patch Mapping (PPM) builds a fine-grained, per-patch positional correspondence between M pose keypoints and N patches via a learned similarity S = gamma*D_M - eta*S_M that combines an affine-extended Mahalanobis distance and affine-extended cosine similarity, gates out low-confidence keypoints by a heatmap-confidence threshold, and selects the argmax-similarity patch per keypoint, thereby down-weighting occluded patches without coarse global pose mapping. A Texture-Aware Decoder (context-extraction MHSA layers + texture-extraction MHCA layers using pose-filtered features as queries) leverages texture distinctiveness to separate the target from non-target pedestrian occluders. An auxiliary pose loss penalizes high cosine similarity between human-part and non-human (background) features.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4651:./reassess/r_3.md:7995:./reassess/r_3.md:4483:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:22:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas for occluded ReID. (1) The pose loss L_p that explicitly minimizes cosine similarity between body-part features and non-human/background features — a cheap regularizer to suppress occluder/background leakage into the identity embedding, applicable to any pose- or part-based occluded model. (2) The texture-distinctiveness decoder channel aimed specifically at non-target PEDESTRIAN occlusion: when the occluder is itself a person, pose/structure cues fail (same skeleton topology), so using texture appearance distinctiveness (via pose-filtered queries cross-attending to contextual features) to push apart target vs distractor-person is a concrete mechanism for the under-addressed person-on-person occlusion case. Also transferable: replacing coarse pose-to-global mapping with a per-keypoint-to-patch confidence-gated argmax correspondence (Mahalanobis+cosine affine similarity) to localize visible regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4652:./reassess/r_3.md:7999:./reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4653:./reassess/r_3.md:8003:./reassess/r_3.md:4491:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:86:"transfer_to_occluded": "Apply the text-level orthogonal-projection disentanglement to occlusion: learn a dual prompt for the OCCLUDER/distractor (e.g. \"a photo of the [X]...[X] occluder\") alongside the ID prompt, then orthogonalize the occluder text feature out of the ID text feature (F_ort = F_id - proj of F_occ onto F_id) and use the purged ID text feature to guide the visual encoder via the non-local SIM. Because the non-local operation aggregates from spatially distant but semantically relevant regions, it is well suited to occluded ReID where visible body parts are scattered far from the occluded/corrupted region — letting the model pull ID evidence from non-adjacent visible patches rather than local self-attention that gets dominated by the occluder. The orthogonalization gives a clean way to subtract a known nuisance direction (occluder appearance) without an auxiliary parser.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4655:./reassess/r_3.md:8005:./reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4656:./reassess/r_3.md:8010:./reassess/r_3.md:4500:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:142:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use an off-the-shelf 3D body reconstruction (SMPL/HMR) of the pedestrian to generate geometric reference points, then drive deformable cross-attention so the image-feature sampling locations are anchored at projected body-keypoint/mesh positions. For occluded ReID this gives a body-structure prior independent of pixel evidence: even when a region is occluded, the reconstructed mesh still provides a body-anchored query, steering attention onto plausible person regions and away from distractor occluders, and the pose/shape-derived reference points act as a soft visibility/structure guide. The SSTI idea of an appearance-independent shape descriptor (from β only) is also a complementary, occlusion-robust feature since estimated body shape is less corrupted by occluders than RGB texture.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4662:./reassess/r_3.md:8062:./pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4732:./reassess/r_3.md:8450:本地 GOPL kill-switch 设计已经明确把“2D 可见性解释同样强”列为致命红线；用户给出的新结果正好击中这条红线。遮挡 source-separation 只有一条很窄的生路：它必须把隐藏变量从“目标缺失多少”换成“遮挡者身份向量具体污染了谁”，并且压掉这部分后直接提高 ReID，而不是又回到 occlusion-count。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:4734:./reassess/r_3.md:8476:角色=**遮挡最后一搏**。p_3提的遮挡source-separation(occlusion=别人身份污染target embedding, donor-ID泄漏)值不值得测? 但必须面对历史'occluder-gate是墙'(exp109: 即使gate掉遮挡, headroom是identity-conditioned不可实现)。设计**最锋利最便宜的kill-switch, 且必须同时回答'压制donor-ID泄漏能不能真涨ReID'**(不只是证泄漏存在——泄漏存在但压了不涨=撞墙=没用)。联网查novelty(撞TTPM/non-target-pedestrian-occlusion那批没)。如果连这都救不动或必撞墙, 诚实说'遮挡这块彻底关'。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:388:> **GOPL**：SMPL 共同可见表面 overlap 只当 **same-ID positive edge 的可靠性度量**——高 overlap 早期强拉、低 overlap 延迟/弱约束/桥接。SMPL **不进身份表征、不做推理匹配、不做 part alignment、不做增广**（绕开 exp333 SMPL-β≈random + VPM/QPM/visibility 红海 + GSAlign/ViSA aerial-ground 红海）。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:394:- **实验硬门槛**: 必须 beat ① random/loss-self-paced ② feature-distance hard/moderate positive mining ③ **2D-part-visibility / VPM-QPM-style overlap**。③最关键——若 2D 关节可见性解释得一样好, GOPL=老visibility换名, 死。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:402:- `cov2d(i,j)` = 2D 关节共同可见 IoU = |vis_i ∩ vis_j| / |vis_i ∪ vis_j|（**这就是 VPM/QPM 式 2D-visibility 对照**）。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:403:- `cov3d(i,j)` = 用 j3d + 相机朝向估每关节"表面是否朝向相机可见"（自遮挡), 再算共同可见 IoU（**这才是 GOPL 主张的 SMPL-3D**, 若 verts 需要 agent 按需重算 ROMP mesh; 关节级先做近似）。

A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10628:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5569:./reassess/r_2.md:1917:reassess/r_3.md:4487:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:45:"mechanism": "FLaN-Net builds a CLIP-based pipeline that constructs an occlusion-aware fine-grained textual prompt \"A photo of a [S*] person with [A*] partially occluded by [O*],\" where three categorical pseudo-word tokens are learned by textual inversion from the image: S* (subject/identity description), A* (visible attributes), and O* (the occluding object). A* and O* are each produced by a separate fine-grained noise-filtering network in which a small set of learnable queries cross-attend to local patch features (so different query categories latch onto visible-attribute regions vs. occluder regions), then average-pool into a token. A cross-attention module uses the textual prompt as query and visual features as key/value (s_att) to steer the image encoder toward visible, identity-relevant regions, and a dynamic weighting fusion module combines global-visual, textual, and cross-attention features with weights derived from each feature's prediction-entropy (uncertainty), giving reliable features larger weight. Trained with contrastive + triplet + ID + ArcFace losses; inference uses only the image-encoder feature.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10629:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5570:./reassess/r_2.md:1918:reassess/r_3.md:4490:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:78:"transfer_to_occluded": "Recast the occluder as a confounder and apply the same backdoor-adjustment recipe: build an \"Occluder Dictionary\" of occlusion patterns/regions stored as Gaussians with priors P(occluder), then train with P(Y|do(X))=Σ_occluder P(Y|X,occluder)·P(occluder), marginalizing over occluders so the model cannot exploit occluder-identity spurious correlations (e.g. a particular bicycle/car/pole co-occurring with certain galleries or cameras). Two concretely transferable tricks: (1) the reverse-attention masking that isolates the confounder feature from the identity feature map — directly usable to separate occluder-region features from body features without external segmentation; (2) representing each confounder as a sampled Gaussian rather than a stored feature, giving cheap synthetic occluder augmentation at the feature level. The NWGM trick keeps the marginalization a single classification, so it's nearly free at training time and zero-cost at inference.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10630:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:5571:./reassess/r_2.md:1922:reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",

In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. /Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14566:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5422:reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14637:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:5832:reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14875:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:2849:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/pivot/p_2.md:836:./analyses/deep_4.txt:55:2. 重定义动作：他们把遮挡问题重定义成 language-guided noise filtering，而不是简单的 visible part matching。更关键的是，他们把图像内容拆成三个语义类别：主体身份、可见属性、遮挡物。关键词是 categorical attention、fine-grained prompt、occlusion-aware prompt、subject token、attribute token、context token。这个重定义把“遮挡”从一个空间缺失问题变成了一个语义分类和噪声过滤问题。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15063:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15064:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15412:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:7887:./reassess/r_3.md:3294:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_1.md:16:- **死2(刚)**: GOPL'正样本关系粒度错了'(用 SMPL 共同可见人体表面 overlap 当 same-ID 正边可靠性)。冻结最强 occluded_duke ckpt(exp255, sanity mAP73.05≈训练73.2)测: cosine 距离确实弱负相关 overlap(rho≈-0.13)但: D5 随机关节子集打平(-0.1294≈真-0.1273)、cov2d 控住可见关节数后归零(+0.0145)、#vis 关节数 baseline 反而更强(-0.1321)、相机对(视角差)解释方差 eta²0.062 比 SMPL cov 0.018 还大、cov3d(3D自遮挡)没明显强于 cov2d → 隐藏变量是'遮挡越重越难'(occlusion-count)不是'共同可见表面', SMPL 几何=VPM/QPM/occlusion-count 换名无独特信号。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15420:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8007:./reassess/r_3.md:4495:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:110:"transfer_to_occluded": "Two directly usable ideas (the paper IS occluded ReID, so these are native): (1) The attention-magnitude saliency for foreground/background separation — derive a per-patch foreground probability from a lightweight conv-sigmoid head trained ONLY by a foreground-background contrastive loss (no pose/parsing labels), then suppress occluder/background tokens; this is an external-prior-free occluder gate, attractive because pose estimators fail under occlusion. (2) The importance-ranked cumulative fusion (FHFM): rank patches by CLS-attention*norm and let high-confidence (likely visible) patches contribute to every fusion level while low-importance (likely occluded) patches contribute least — a soft, label-free visibility weighting that downweights corrupted regions without a hard mask. The region-restricted masked attention with learnable part tokens is also a clean parsing-free way to get part features robust to missing regions.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15421:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8009:./reassess/r_3.md:4497:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:126:"transfer_to_occluded": "The Intersection-Alignment Score (IAS) explainable re-ranking is directly occlusion-relevant: compute IoU between the model's activation/attention map and a visible-region (non-occluded) mask, plus a cosine alignment between query and gallery activation maps, then refine the distance matrix — multiply distance by alpha<1 when attention focuses on visible regions AND query/gallery attentions agree, and by beta>1 when attention falls on occluded/missing regions. In occluded ReID this is a self-supervised matching-side trust mechanism: down-weight matches whose discriminative evidence sits on occluder/missing pixels and reward query-gallery pairs whose visible-region attention co-aligns, without needing identity-level supervision. The canonical-UV idea (mapping body regions to fixed coordinates so the same part always aligns) is also a clean way to make two partially-occluded crops compare only on their commonly-visible parts.",
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:15422:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_3.md:8032:./reassess/r_3.md:4760:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/overnight_innovation_log.md:420:1. ⭐ **因果 backdoor-triplet**(搬 gait GaitC3I TIP25/GaitSCM CVIU24)：把 camera-id+occlusion-state 当显式混淆变量 C, backdoor adjustment 改 triplet 正样本采样, 让跨遮挡/跨摄像头正样本对不再发协变量差异冒充身份的有害梯度。仓库零因果/SCM 代码(唯一命中 DACHM/DACCM 是 training-free reranker, 另一 lever)。**唯一同时满足: 问题重定义+机制新+零代码+避所有已死框架**。遮挡状态从 pose 可见性直接得。0.5天无训练首验。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:17524:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess/r_2.md:1920:reassess/r_3.md:4493:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/transfer_candidates.json:102:"transfer_to_occluded": "Use real out-of-domain vehicle (or generic object) crops as the occluder source for copy-paste augmentation instead of synthetic gray patches or random erasing, and inject them with a controlled height-ratio so the paste lands on the lower body to mimic real vehicle-induced occlusion. This produces texture-and-color-realistic distractor occluders that better match deployment-time occlusions than random-erasing, and the epoch-wise alternation between clean and occluder-domain data acts as a regularizer pushing the model toward occlusion-invariant features — both are drop-in, annotation-free, and backbone-agnostic for any occluded ReID pipeline.",

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:4:## re-frame（破解前3死根因: 它们都是 retrieval/topology-side 被 test-time 工具碾压; OSAC 是 training-side）
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:5:> 大家以为 ReID 训练越把同 ID 压紧越好。其实 **open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期类内方差坍缩、特征过度对齐到 seen-ID classifier/prototype 几何，**unseen-ID 的可迁移身份证据被低秩化/各向异性化、挤到低能谱尾部**。测试是 unseen-ID 检索，k-reciprocal/camera-aware 只能**重排已有距离**，恢复不了被训练压没的维度。**Hubness(gallery 负向 in-degree)是这个过坍缩的检索症状, 不是根因。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:8:- Neural Collapse(Papyan 2020)已定义训练末期坍缩, 但**没人把"过坍缩伤 open-set ReID 的 unseen 迁移"当可测失败变量 + 训练期抗坍缩**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:9:- vs k-reciprocal/CA-Jaccard: 它们 test-time 重排, **碰不到训练表征**(OSAC 核心优势)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:11:- vs VICReg/whitening/decorrelation/AMS group-whitening: 是通用泛化零件, **主贡献不能写"decorrelation loss"**, 必须写"open-set ReID 过坍缩诊断 + 训练期 spectral anti-collapse 保 unseen 证据"。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:18:- effective rank = exp(entropy(λ_i/Σλ)) 或 (Σλ)²/Σλ²; top-PC energy λ1/Σλ。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:24:1. **过坍缩轨迹**: 训练后期(ep80→120) loss 继续降, 但 effective rank **下降** / top-PC energy **上升** / NC1 下降。→ 证"过坍缩"存在。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:25:2. **坍缩↔检索失败相关**: per-query AP error ~ (query 在 top-PC 上的投影能量 / prototype alignment) 相关, **控 camera/norm/margin 后仍显著**。hub mass M(q) ~ top-PC energy 相关(证 hubness 是坍缩症状)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:26:3. **去坍缩诊断干预(零训练)**: 对 embedding 做 ABTT(去 top-m PC) / whitening, 看 (a)hubness 是否降, (b)raw mAP 是否可见提升。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:29:- D1 随机 PC / bottom-PC removal → 必须**不如** top-PC removal(否则不是坍缩信号是噪声)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:30:- D2 **去坍缩 vs k-reciprocal**: 若 ABTT/whitening 只涨 raw, 但 **k-reciprocal 之后完全无残余增益** → 判死(又被 re-ranking 吃掉, 同 Hubness 教训)。**这条最关键——必须证训练表征侧有 k-reciprocal 拿不到的东西。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:31:- D3 控 camera/norm/margin 后 top-PC↔AP 相关消失 → 判死(普通难度代理)。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:104:| (a) Neural Collapse 到 ReID/open-set/metric learning | **存活，强相邻撞车** | Papyan NC 已定义 train class feature 向 class mean / ETF / classifier self-dual collapse。NC 已用于 transfer/OOD/OSR 解释或检测，且 Galanti 甚至说 NC 可泛化到新类；Hui 则指出 NC 可能让 downstream feature 变差。**没查到把 NC 明确落到 person ReID seen-ID 过坍缩作为 open-set ReID 失败变量**。证据：[Papyan 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.08186)、[Hui 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.08384)、[Galanti 2021](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15121)、[NC-OOD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01479)、[NECO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06823) | 8/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:105:| (b) SSL/contrastive dimensional collapse | **机制撞车，问题存活** | Jing/Hua 已经把“维度坍缩、强相关、低维子空间”讲得很清楚。OSAC 的“低秩化/各向异性化”概念不能当新现象，只能当迁移到 ReID 的诊断变量。证据：[Jing et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348)、[Hua et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.00470) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:106:| (c) VICReg / Barlow / whitening / decorrelation | **零件严重撞车** | spectral floor 类似 VICReg variance floor；去相关/白化类似 Barlow Twins、Whitening SSL。不能声称“防 collapse 的谱地板/去相关”新。切口在 supervised open-set ReID 的 seen-ID prototype over-collapse，而非 SSL collapse。证据：[VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906)、[Barlow Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03230)、[Whitening SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06346) | 10/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:107:| (d) ProNet / prototype projection / classifier reuse ReID | **强相邻撞车，有杀伤** | ProNet 直接把 ReID classifier 权重当 seen-ID prototypes，并在推理时保留 prototype similarity 做检索特征。这会挑战“seen prototype 对齐一定伤 unseen”。但它没有诊断过坍缩，也不是训练期谱抗坍缩，且测试不是“仍单原始 embedding”。必须做 ProNet/ProNet-like 对照。证据：[ProNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10717) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:108:| (e) open-set / DG ReID 是否已有“过坍缩伤 unseen” | **核心切口存活** | Open-set ReID/GOM 已强调 query ID 可能不在 gallery、ReID 是 retrieval+verification；DG ReID 多数讲 domain/style overfit，不是 seen-ID neural collapse。没看到“训练末期 seen-ID prototype collapse 压掉 unseen identity evidence”的诊断。证据：[GOM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.11506)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[MetaBIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.14670)、[Style Interleaved](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.03132) | 8/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:109:| (f) feature whitening / GW / IN 类 ReID | **中等撞车** | AMS 已用 IN + Group Whitening 做 DG ReID；SNR 明确说 IN 会丢 identity-relevant 信息再 restitution；CC-ReID 也有 feature decorrelation。OSAC 要避开“又一个 whitening ReID”叙事，强调 classifier-prototype over-collapse 与谱尾 unseen 证据。证据：[AMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10409)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[CC-ReID decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05536)、[RaMoE decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.09156) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:116:OSAC 要站住，实验必须证明三件事：  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:117:1. baseline 训练末期出现 effective rank 下降、谱尾能量下降、top-PC 与 classifier/prototype subspace 对齐增强，并且这些量和 unseen mAP/R1 负相关。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:118:2. k-reciprocal/re-ranking 只能重排邻域，不能恢复 embedding 谱维度；OSAC 不靠 test-time trick。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:119:3. OSAC 胜过 VICReg-like variance/cov、GW/whitening、random dropout、early stopping、label smoothing、ProNet/ProNet-like prototype feature 等强对照。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:122:截至 2026-06-24 检索后的判断：**OSAC 主切口存活，但机制零件撞车很多**。不能把“variance/covariance/whitening/谱正则防 collapse”写成主创新；主创新必须写成 **open-set ReID 中 seen-ID prototype 几何过强导致 unseen 身份证据谱尾化，并用训练期抗坍缩保护单 embedding 的可迁移维度**。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2097:./ondisk_pivot.md:2783:./debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2099:./ondisk_pivot.md:2790:./debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2101:./ondisk_pivot.md:2793:./debate/d_2.md:92:   近年的 CA-Jaccard 明确指出 camera variation 会让 Jaccard/re-ranking 邻域被 intra-camera samples 主导，带来 intra-camera negatives、排除 inter-camera positives；它用 camera-aware k-reciprocal neighbor 和 local query expansion 修正。你的 D2 里同相机降权直接赢 hub penalty，说明 hubness 可能仍被 camera topology 解释/覆盖一部分。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2139:./ondisk_pivot.md:3784:./OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:35:→ 全过(尤其 D2 残余) = 过坍缩是 k-reciprocal 拿不到的真 training-side 失败变量 → 单训练 kill-switch(强 baseline 加 OSAC: spectral floor + Top-PC Dropout, 测试仍单 embedding; ep30/60 看 effective rank↑/top-PC hub correlation↓/raw +0.5 稳; 成功线 raw +0.8~1.0 且 k-reciprocal/camera 后仍 +0.3 残余)。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4521:./debate/d_1.md:86:Market 的 D2 mAP 弱不能过度解读。你们 Market 已经 94.6 mAP，headroom 极低；而 MSMT17 原论文明确设计成更大、更真实、更难，有 15 camera、复杂光照/场景、4101 IDs/126441 boxes。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.08565)) Occluded ReID 又天然有 missing/noisy information。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.04712)) 一个 2025 ReID re-ranking 结果也显示，邻域/拓扑类后处理在 MSMT17、Occluded-DukeMTMC 的 R1 增益远大于 Market。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.04050)) 这正支持“Market 看不出，难集会放大 hub 病”的判断。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4527:./debate/d_1.md:120:Market 的 D2 mAP 弱不能过度解读。你们 Market 已经 94.6 mAP，headroom 极低；而 MSMT17 原论文明确设计成更大、更真实、更难，有 15 camera、复杂光照/场景、4101 IDs/126441 boxes。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.08565)) Occluded ReID 又天然有 missing/noisy information。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.04712)) 一个 2025 ReID re-ranking 结果也显示，邻域/拓扑类后处理在 MSMT17、Occluded-DukeMTMC 的 R1 增益远大于 Market。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.04050)) 这正支持“Market 看不出，难集会放大 hub 病”的判断。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4765:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:3:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4768:./debate/clean/d_2.txt:16:   近年的 CA-Jaccard 明确指出 camera variation 会让 Jaccard/re-ranking 邻域被 intra-camera samples 主导，带来 intra-camera negatives、排除 inter-camera positives；它用 camera-aware k-reciprocal neighbor 和 local query expansion 修正。你的 D2 里同相机降权直接赢 hub penalty，说明 hubness 可能仍被 camera topology 解释/覆盖一部分。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:4772:./debate/clean/d_1.txt:8:Market 的 D2 mAP 弱不能过度解读。你们 Market 已经 94.6 mAP，headroom 极低；而 MSMT17 原论文明确设计成更大、更真实、更难，有 15 camera、复杂光照/场景、4101 IDs/126441 boxes。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1711.08565)) Occluded ReID 又天然有 missing/noisy information。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2212.04712)) 一个 2025 ReID re-ranking 结果也显示，邻域/拓扑类后处理在 MSMT17、Occluded-DukeMTMC 的 R1 增益远大于 Market。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.04050)) 这正支持“Market 看不出，难集会放大 hub 病”的判断。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:428:我们要做 ReID 方法 **OSAC(Open-Set Spectral Over-Collapse)**。重定义: open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 **seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期特征过度对齐 seen-ID prototype 几何, unseen-ID 可迁移身份证据低秩化/各向异性化挤到低能谱尾部; k-reciprocal 只能重排恢复不了被压没的维度。hubness 是症状非根因。机制: 训练期 spectral anti-collapse(spectral floor + Top-PC Dropout)保 unseen 证据, 测试仍单 embedding。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:430:用联网**尽力查确切先例+撞车**, 逐类判它们是否已把'seen-ID 过坍缩定义成 open-set ReID 失败变量 + 训练期抗坍缩保 unseen 迁移': (a)Neural Collapse(Papyan 2020)用到 ReID / open-set / metric learning 没; (b)dimensional collapse / rank collapse in SSL/contrastive(Jing et al, Hua et al); (c)VICReg/Barlow Twins/whitening/decorrelation 泛化零件; (d)ProNet / prototype-projection / classifier-reuse ReID; (e)generalizable/open-set/DG ReID 里有没有'过坍缩伤 unseen 迁移'诊断; (f)feature whitening / group whitening ReID(AMS / SNR / IN 类); (g)spectral/rank regularization metric learning; (h)open-set recognition 里的 feature collapse。撞了说撞哪+杀伤; 没撞说切口。务实中文, verdict(撞车/存活)+证据链接+信心1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:432:我会按你列的八类逐一查最近和经典先例，重点不是泛泛找“谱/白化/collapse”，而是确认有没有把它精确定义为 open-set ReID 的 seen-ID 过坍缩失效变量，并且训练期用谱抗坍缩保护 unseen 证据。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:446:web search: person re-identification feature whitening group whitening AMS SNR IN
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:514:截至 2026-06-24 检索后的判断：**OSAC 主切口存活，但机制零件撞车很多**。不能把“variance/covariance/whitening/谱正则防 collapse”写成主创新；主创新必须写成 **open-set ReID 中 seen-ID prototype 几何过强导致 unseen 身份证据谱尾化，并用训练期抗坍缩保护单 embedding 的可迁移维度**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:518:| (a) Neural Collapse 到 ReID/open-set/metric learning | **存活，强相邻撞车** | Papyan NC 已定义 train class feature 向 class mean / ETF / classifier self-dual collapse。NC 已用于 transfer/OOD/OSR 解释或检测，且 Galanti 甚至说 NC 可泛化到新类；Hui 则指出 NC 可能让 downstream feature 变差。**没查到把 NC 明确落到 person ReID seen-ID 过坍缩作为 open-set ReID 失败变量**。证据：[Papyan 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.08186)、[Hui 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.08384)、[Galanti 2021](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15121)、[NC-OOD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01479)、[NECO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06823) | 8/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:519:| (b) SSL/contrastive dimensional collapse | **机制撞车，问题存活** | Jing/Hua 已经把“维度坍缩、强相关、低维子空间”讲得很清楚。OSAC 的“低秩化/各向异性化”概念不能当新现象，只能当迁移到 ReID 的诊断变量。证据：[Jing et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348)、[Hua et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.00470) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:520:| (c) VICReg / Barlow / whitening / decorrelation | **零件严重撞车** | spectral floor 类似 VICReg variance floor；去相关/白化类似 Barlow Twins、Whitening SSL。不能声称“防 collapse 的谱地板/去相关”新。切口在 supervised open-set ReID 的 seen-ID prototype over-collapse，而非 SSL collapse。证据：[VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906)、[Barlow Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03230)、[Whitening SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06346) | 10/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:521:| (d) ProNet / prototype projection / classifier reuse ReID | **强相邻撞车，有杀伤** | ProNet 直接把 ReID classifier 权重当 seen-ID prototypes，并在推理时保留 prototype similarity 做检索特征。这会挑战“seen prototype 对齐一定伤 unseen”。但它没有诊断过坍缩，也不是训练期谱抗坍缩，且测试不是“仍单原始 embedding”。必须做 ProNet/ProNet-like 对照。证据：[ProNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10717) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:522:| (e) open-set / DG ReID 是否已有“过坍缩伤 unseen” | **核心切口存活** | Open-set ReID/GOM 已强调 query ID 可能不在 gallery、ReID 是 retrieval+verification；DG ReID 多数讲 domain/style overfit，不是 seen-ID neural collapse。没看到“训练末期 seen-ID prototype collapse 压掉 unseen identity evidence”的诊断。证据：[GOM](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.11506)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[MetaBIN](https://arxiv.org/abs/2011.14670)、[Style Interleaved](https://arxiv.org/abs/2207.03132) | 8/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:523:| (f) feature whitening / GW / IN 类 ReID | **中等撞车** | AMS 已用 IN + Group Whitening 做 DG ReID；SNR 明确说 IN 会丢 identity-relevant 信息再 restitution；CC-ReID 也有 feature decorrelation。OSAC 要避开“又一个 whitening ReID”叙事，强调 classifier-prototype over-collapse 与谱尾 unseen 证据。证据：[AMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10409)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[CC-ReID decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05536)、[RaMoE decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.09156) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:530:OSAC 要站住，实验必须证明三件事：  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:531:1. baseline 训练末期出现 effective rank 下降、谱尾能量下降、top-PC 与 classifier/prototype subspace 对齐增强，并且这些量和 unseen mAP/R1 负相关。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:532:2. k-reciprocal/re-ranking 只能重排邻域，不能恢复 embedding 谱维度；OSAC 不靠 test-time trick。  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/ondisk_pivot.md:533:3. OSAC 胜过 VICReg-like variance/cov、GW/whitening、random dropout、early stopping、label smoothing、ProNet/ProNet-like prototype feature 等强对照。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:471:## re-frame（破解前3死根因: 它们都是 retrieval/topology-side 被 test-time 工具碾压; OSAC 是 training-side）
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:472:> 大家以为 ReID 训练越把同 ID 压紧越好。其实 **open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期类内方差坍缩、特征过度对齐到 seen-ID classifier/prototype 几何，**unseen-ID 的可迁移身份证据被低秩化/各向异性化、挤到低能谱尾部**。测试是 unseen-ID 检索，k-reciprocal/camera-aware 只能**重排已有距离**，恢复不了被训练压没的维度。**Hubness(gallery 负向 in-degree)是这个过坍缩的检索症状, 不是根因。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:475:- Neural Collapse(Papyan 2020)已定义训练末期坍缩, 但**没人把"过坍缩伤 open-set ReID 的 unseen 迁移"当可测失败变量 + 训练期抗坍缩**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:476:- vs k-reciprocal/CA-Jaccard: 它们 test-time 重排, **碰不到训练表征**(OSAC 核心优势)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:478:- vs VICReg/whitening/decorrelation/AMS group-whitening: 是通用泛化零件, **主贡献不能写"decorrelation loss"**, 必须写"open-set ReID 过坍缩诊断 + 训练期 spectral anti-collapse 保 unseen 证据"。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:485:- effective rank = exp(entropy(λ_i/Σλ)) 或 (Σλ)²/Σλ²; top-PC energy λ1/Σλ。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:491:1. **过坍缩轨迹**: 训练后期(ep80→120) loss 继续降, 但 effective rank **下降** / top-PC energy **上升** / NC1 下降。→ 证"过坍缩"存在。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1027:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:2:（2026-06-24, B+GOPL+Hubness 三死后, reassess2 x_2 主推; 第一个 training-side 候选）

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1029:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:5:> 大家以为 ReID 训练越把同 ID 压紧越好。其实 **open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期类内方差坍缩、特征过度对齐到 seen-ID classifier/prototype 几何，**unseen-ID 的可迁移身份证据被低秩化/各向异性化、挤到低能谱尾部**。测试是 unseen-ID 检索，k-reciprocal/camera-aware 只能**重排已有距离**，恢复不了被训练压没的维度。**Hubness(gallery 负向 in-degree)是这个过坍缩的检索症状, 不是根因。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1030:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:9:- vs k-reciprocal/CA-Jaccard: 它们 test-time 重排, **碰不到训练表征**(OSAC 核心优势)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1031:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:18:- effective rank = exp(entropy(λ_i/Σλ)) 或 (Σλ)²/Σλ²; top-PC energy λ1/Σλ。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1032:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:24:1. **过坍缩轨迹**: 训练后期(ep80→120) loss 继续降, 但 effective rank **下降** / top-PC energy **上升** / NC1 下降。→ 证"过坍缩"存在。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1167:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:471:## re-frame（破解前3死根因: 它们都是 retrieval/topology-side 被 test-time 工具碾压; OSAC 是 training-side）
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1168:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:472:> 大家以为 ReID 训练越把同 ID 压紧越好。其实 **open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期类内方差坍缩、特征过度对齐到 seen-ID classifier/prototype 几何，**unseen-ID 的可迁移身份证据被低秩化/各向异性化、挤到低能谱尾部**。测试是 unseen-ID 检索，k-reciprocal/camera-aware 只能**重排已有距离**，恢复不了被训练压没的维度。**Hubness(gallery 负向 in-degree)是这个过坍缩的检索症状, 不是根因。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1169:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:476:- vs k-reciprocal/CA-Jaccard: 它们 test-time 重排, **碰不到训练表征**(OSAC 核心优势)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1170:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:485:- effective rank = exp(entropy(λ_i/Σλ)) 或 (Σλ)²/Σλ²; top-PC energy λ1/Σλ。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1171:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:491:1. **过坍缩轨迹**: 训练后期(ep80→120) loss 继续降, 但 effective rank **下降** / top-PC energy **上升** / NC1 下降。→ 证"过坍缩"存在。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1172:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:497:- D2 **去坍缩 vs k-reciprocal**: 若 ABTT/whitening 只涨 raw, 但 **k-reciprocal 之后完全无残余增益** → 判死(又被 re-ranking 吃掉, 同 Hubness 教训)。**这条最关键——必须证训练表征侧有 k-reciprocal 拿不到的东西。**
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1173:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:501:**通过标准:** 过坍缩轨迹明确(ep后期 rank↓) + AP error ~ top-PC energy partial 显著 + ABTT 降 hubness 涨 raw + **D1 随机PC不如top-PC + D2 ABTT 在 k-reciprocal 之后仍有残余增益 + D3 控代理后仍在**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1174:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:502:→ 全过(尤其 D2 残余) = 过坍缩是 k-reciprocal 拿不到的真 training-side 失败变量 → 单训练 kill-switch(强 baseline 加 OSAC: spectral floor + Top-PC Dropout, 测试仍单 embedding; ep30/60 看 effective rank↑/top-PC hub correlation↓/raw +0.5 稳; 成功线 raw +0.8~1.0 且 k-reciprocal/camera 后仍 +0.3 残余)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1175:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:503:→ D2 不过(去坍缩被 k-reciprocal 吃掉) = OSAC 也死, 那就接受 x_1 终判: image-level frozen 彻底收, 转视频 AG-VPReID 或把 Hubness 写成 analysis short。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1176:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:506:OSAC: ① warmup 后 BNNeck embedding 算 batch/memory covariance spectrum; ② 轻量 spectral floor(提 effective rank/限 top-PC energy); ③ Top-PC Dropout(stop-grad 估 top PCs, 一条 loss 分支随机减 top-m PC 再 CE/triplet, 迫使身份信息不只走 dominant axes); ④ clean branch 保原 CE/triplet 避免过度反坍缩伤主干。测试不变, 单 embedding。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1624:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:1629:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:8894:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/OSAC_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:5:> 大家以为 ReID 训练越把同 ID 压紧越好。其实 **open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期类内方差坍缩、特征过度对齐到 seen-ID classifier/prototype 几何，**unseen-ID 的可迁移身份证据被低秩化/各向异性化、挤到低能谱尾部**。测试是 unseen-ID 检索，k-reciprocal/camera-aware 只能**重排已有距离**，恢复不了被训练压没的维度。**Hubness(gallery 负向 in-degree)是这个过坍缩的检索症状, 不是根因。**

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10472:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2097:./ondisk_pivot.md:2783:./debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:10473:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_rankinstab.md:2099:./ondisk_pivot.md:2790:./debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12648:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:30:- D2 **bbox/相机对** 当 overlap 代理 → SMPL cov 必须解释更多(更高 Spearman / 更大桶 gap)。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12649:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/GOPL_KILLSWITCH_DESIGN.md:35:**通过标准:** (核心1-4成立) + (D1置换破) + (D2 SMPL>bbox/cam) + (D3 SMPL beyond feature-dist) + **(D4 cov3d>cov2d 明显)**。D4 不过 = GOPL 没独特性, 降级。全过 = GOPL 隐藏变量真实且 SMPL 几何独特, 写训练版(geometry-ordered positive graph + 课程权重, beat random/self-paced/feature-hard/2D-vis 四对照)。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12952:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:14:我们要做 ReID 方法 **OSAC(Open-Set Spectral Over-Collapse)**。重定义: open-set ReID 的隐藏变量是 **seen-ID neural collapse 过强**——训练末期特征过度对齐 seen-ID prototype 几何, unseen-ID 可迁移身份证据低秩化/各向异性化挤到低能谱尾部; k-reciprocal 只能重排恢复不了被压没的维度。hubness 是症状非根因。机制: 训练期 spectral anti-collapse(spectral floor + Top-PC Dropout)保 unseen 证据, 测试仍单 embedding。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12953:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:16:用联网**尽力查确切先例+撞车**, 逐类判它们是否已把'seen-ID 过坍缩定义成 open-set ReID 失败变量 + 训练期抗坍缩保 unseen 迁移': (a)Neural Collapse(Papyan 2020)用到 ReID / open-set / metric learning 没; (b)dimensional collapse / rank collapse in SSL/contrastive(Jing et al, Hua et al); (c)VICReg/Barlow Twins/whitening/decorrelation 泛化零件; (d)ProNet / prototype-projection / classifier-reuse ReID; (e)generalizable/open-set/DG ReID 里有没有'过坍缩伤 unseen 迁移'诊断; (f)feature whitening / group whitening ReID(AMS / SNR / IN 类); (g)spectral/rank regularization metric learning; (h)open-set recognition 里的 feature collapse。撞了说撞哪+杀伤; 没撞说切口。务实中文, verdict(撞车/存活)+证据链接+信心1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12954:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:18:我会按你列的八类逐一查最近和经典先例，重点不是泛泛找“谱/白化/collapse”，而是确认有没有把它精确定义为 open-set ReID 的 seen-ID 过坍缩失效变量，并且训练期用谱抗坍缩保护 unseen 证据。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12956:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:32:web search: person re-identification feature whitening group whitening AMS SNR IN
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12961:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:100:截至 2026-06-24 检索后的判断：**OSAC 主切口存活，但机制零件撞车很多**。不能把“variance/covariance/whitening/谱正则防 collapse”写成主创新；主创新必须写成 **open-set ReID 中 seen-ID prototype 几何过强导致 unseen 身份证据谱尾化，并用训练期抗坍缩保护单 embedding 的可迁移维度**。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12962:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:104:| (a) Neural Collapse 到 ReID/open-set/metric learning | **存活，强相邻撞车** | Papyan NC 已定义 train class feature 向 class mean / ETF / classifier self-dual collapse。NC 已用于 transfer/OOD/OSR 解释或检测，且 Galanti 甚至说 NC 可泛化到新类；Hui 则指出 NC 可能让 downstream feature 变差。**没查到把 NC 明确落到 person ReID seen-ID 过坍缩作为 open-set ReID 失败变量**。证据：[Papyan 2020](https://arxiv.org/abs/2008.08186)、[Hui 2022](https://arxiv.org/abs/2202.08384)、[Galanti 2021](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15121)、[NC-OOD](https://arxiv.org/abs/2311.01479)、[NECO](https://arxiv.org/abs/2310.06823) | 8/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12963:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:105:| (b) SSL/contrastive dimensional collapse | **机制撞车，问题存活** | Jing/Hua 已经把“维度坍缩、强相关、低维子空间”讲得很清楚。OSAC 的“低秩化/各向异性化”概念不能当新现象，只能当迁移到 ReID 的诊断变量。证据：[Jing et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348)、[Hua et al.](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.00470) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12964:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:106:| (c) VICReg / Barlow / whitening / decorrelation | **零件严重撞车** | spectral floor 类似 VICReg variance floor；去相关/白化类似 Barlow Twins、Whitening SSL。不能声称“防 collapse 的谱地板/去相关”新。切口在 supervised open-set ReID 的 seen-ID prototype over-collapse，而非 SSL collapse。证据：[VICReg](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906)、[Barlow Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2103.03230)、[Whitening SSL](https://arxiv.org/abs/2007.06346) | 10/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12965:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:107:| (d) ProNet / prototype projection / classifier reuse ReID | **强相邻撞车，有杀伤** | ProNet 直接把 ReID classifier 权重当 seen-ID prototypes，并在推理时保留 prototype similarity 做检索特征。这会挑战“seen prototype 对齐一定伤 unseen”。但它没有诊断过坍缩，也不是训练期谱抗坍缩，且测试不是“仍单原始 embedding”。必须做 ProNet/ProNet-like 对照。证据：[ProNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.10717) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12966:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:109:| (f) feature whitening / GW / IN 类 ReID | **中等撞车** | AMS 已用 IN + Group Whitening 做 DG ReID；SNR 明确说 IN 会丢 identity-relevant 信息再 restitution；CC-ReID 也有 feature decorrelation。OSAC 要避开“又一个 whitening ReID”叙事，强调 classifier-prototype over-collapse 与谱尾 unseen 证据。证据：[AMS](https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.10409)、[SNR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2005.11037)、[CC-ReID decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2410.05536)、[RaMoE decorrelation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.09156) | 9/10 |
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12969:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:116:OSAC 要站住，实验必须证明三件事：  
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:12970:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/novelty_osac.md:117:1. baseline 训练末期出现 effective rank 下降、谱尾能量下降、top-PC 与 classifier/prototype subspace 对齐增强，并且这些量和 unseen mAP/R1 负相关。

/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14287:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2625:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2429:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:25:角色=**蓝队(降级 Hubness)**。为'别投训练, 降级转 r_2 备胎 Rank-Instability'辩护: D2 是铁证——k-reciprocal/camera **免费 test-time** 就在 mAP 上赢, 一个训练版要 beat camera-aware k-reciprocal 是高 bar 且小 headroom(Market 饱和)。用联网查: (a)hubness-aware training / anti-hub margin 历史上是否真能 beat 强 re-ranking(还是总被 k-reciprocal 这类盖过); (b)R1 赢 mAP 输是不是只是把 ranking 重排没真增加判别信息; (c)团队反复投不确定训练的教训。论证'诊断真≠方法能发', 该把诊断当一个 observation 写进别的稿/换 r_2。信心 1-10。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14289:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2631:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2439:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:79:蓝队理由很硬：你的 D4 证明的是“Gallery negative hubness 是真实失败结构”，但 D2 证明的是“当前可落地方法入口不够强”。这两件事不能混在一起。零训练 `cos - λlog(1+H_k)` 在 Market 只给 `+0.31 mAP`，而 k-reciprocal `+1.26 mAP`、camera downweight `+0.67 mAP` 都是免费 test-time。训练版如果要成为 CCF-B 方法稿，不能只赢 raw cosine，至少要在 mAP 上打过这些便宜强基线，否则审稿人会说：你发现了 hubness，但有效解法还是 re-ranking/camera prior。
/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/false_negative_audit.md:14292:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_1.md:2635:/Users/abdslm/Desktop/SOLIDER-REID/experiments/cargo_cvpb/litreview2/reassess2/x_2.md:2444:../../cargo_cvpb/litreview2/debate/d_2.md:92:   近年的 CA-Jaccard 明确指出 camera variation 会让 Jaccard/re-ranking 邻域被 intra-camera samples 主导，带来 intra-camera negatives、排除 inter-camera positives；它用 camera-aware k-reciprocal neighbor 和 local query expansion 修正。你的 D2 里同相机降权直接赢 hub penalty，说明 hubness 可能仍被 camera topology 解释/覆盖一部分。

**Verdict**

没有看到明确“活的被当死的”的翻案证据。6 个 KILL 里，B / GOPL / Hubness / OSAC / Rank-Regret 的死因基本可信；唯一最值得做一次零训练复核的是 **⑤ RMA-TIReID**，因为它的死因是“边缘死”，更像测量口径可能过窄，而不是物理/数学硬墙。

**逐项审计**

| 方向 | 反向 audit 结论 | 信心 |
|---|---|---:|
| ① B 航拍不确定性包含 | Kill 基本 robust。TTA 方差确实可能不是“身份欠定度”的完美代理，但本地结果不是只靠 `σ_aerial < σ_ground`：合成退化 σ 不升反降、view-mean σ 反而更好、within-view σ 置换不掉、G→A 崩到 17.37，说明收益不是图像级物理包含，而是方差分母检索 artifact。若换成“视角语义/可见性/几何对齐”，外部已有 GSAlign / SeCap / ViSA 等 AGPReID 方向占位。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2510.22268?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.06965?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.18192?utm_source=openai)) | 8/10 |
| ② GOPL | Kill robust。GOPL 的可发点必须是 SMPL-3D 共同可见提供 2D visibility / occlusion-count 之外的独特信号；若 cov3d≈cov2d 且被 occlusion-count 解释，就退化成 VPM/PVPM/QPM 老线。外部文献里 shared visible parts / visibility-aware part matching 已经是成熟路线。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1904.00537?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2004.00230?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2201.00107?utm_source=openai)) | 8/10 |
| ③ Gallery Hubness remedy | Kill robust，但要分清：单说“被 k-reciprocal 占”略过强，因为训练成 single embedding 理论上还能争部署价值；但 §7.6 新控制更致命，`M(q)` 控 `#false-in-topk` 后偏相关≈0，说明 hubness 诊断本身无增量。k-reciprocal 本来就是 ReID 里标准、无监督、邻域拓扑 re-ranking。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/1701.08398?utm_source=openai)) Hubness 及 hub-aware retrieval 也不是新问题。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2503.10526?utm_source=openai)) | 9/10 |
| ④ OSAC 谱过坍缩 | Kill 基本 robust。训练 effective rank 反升、身份信号在 top-PC 而非谱尾、ABTT/whitening 在 k-recip 后无残余，直接打掉“seen-ID 过坍缩压掉 unseen 谱尾证据”的核心前提。理论上 NC1/类内方差可能和 global rank 不完全等价，但外部 Neural Collapse 文献并不支持“collapse 必然伤 transfer”，甚至有工作认为 NC 可泛化到新类。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2112.15121?utm_source=openai)) 机制零件还撞 VICReg / dimensional collapse / whitening 大路线。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2105.04906?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2110.09348?utm_source=openai)) | 8/10 |
| ⑤ RMA-TIReID | **最可疑，但不是“看起来活”。** 现有 kill 是 token-prototype≈color-only、非颜色 token 约 1 mAP、跨域 R1 49。这个更像“当前 probe 没测到非颜色语义”，不如前几项硬。Text-image ReID 外部主线已经很卷，IRRA/RDE 等都在做 cross-modal/local alignment/noisy correspondence。([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2303.12501?utm_source=openai)) ([arxiv.org](https://arxiv.org/abs/2308.09911?utm_source=openai)) 所以它最多值得一次廉价复核，不值得直接复活。 | 6/10 |
| ⑥ Rank-Regret | Kill 最硬之一。Swin stage0/1 几乎随机，stage2 才可用但已吃 91.7% 算力；这不是统计控制问题，是架构 FLOPs/特征可用性硬墙。再加 RI 被 static difficulty 解释，当前 Swin frozen 设置下无 false-negative。换 ResNet/多-exit 是另一个问题。 | 9.5/10 |

**建议的唯一廉价 re-test**

只复测 **⑤ RMA-TIReID**，零训练即可：

1. 在 RSTPReid 上构造三类文本：full caption、color-only、color-stripped / non-color-only。
2. 做同色 hard subset：只比较颜色词一致的候选，看非颜色 token 是否仍有显著区分力。
3. 做 binding test：保持词集合不变，只交换颜色-部位绑定，例如 “red shirt blue pants” ↔ “blue shirt red pants”。
4. 通过线：non-color 或 binding 信号相对 color-only 至少带来清晰增量，比如 R1/mAP ≥ +3～5，且不是只在少量样例上成立。
5. 若仍约 +1 或跨域仍 R1≈49，RMA kill 确认。

我的总判断：**负结果整体可信，没有需要翻案的主线。** RMA 是唯一值得补一刀的 false-negative 审计点；其余 5 个不建议再花训练资源。
